title: Dev Sênior Mobile Android
description:
A T-Systems, multinacional alemã pertencente ao Grupo Deutsche Telekom, busca Arquiteto(a) Sênior Mobile Android – Kotlin, Compose Multiplatform – Android XR com bom nível de idioma inglês para integrar nossa equipe e ajudar a construir aplicações móveis modernas e multiplataforma.

Você trabalhará com Jetpack Compose, Compose Multiplatform e Kotlin Multiplatform (KMM/KMP) para criar experiências integradas e fluídas para Android e iOS.



O que você fará:

  • Criar produtos digitais inovadores para dispositivos móveis, desde smartphones e tablets até óculos inteligentes com IA
  • Conduzir a evolução sustentável e a melhoria contínua da plataforma mobile
  • Gerenciar requisitos técnicos



O que esperamos:

  • 4 a 6 anos de experiência como Lead/Arquiteto(a) em desenvolvimento Android
  • Forte habilidade de comunicação
  • Sólida experiência com Kotlin, Android e Jetpack Compose
  • Familiaridade com Kotlin Multiplatform (KMM/KMP) e desenvolvimento multiplataforma
  • Conhecimento de MVVM, injeção de dependência (Koin/Hilt) e gerenciamento de estado
  • Experiência com frameworks de mock/teste e desenvolvimento orientado a APIs
  • Paixão por código limpo, reutilizável e por princípios modernos de UI/UX
  • Alto interesse em IA, LLMs e tecnologias emergentes



Diferenciais:

  • Experiência inicial com óculos de IA
  • Interesse elevado ou motivação intrínseca por óculos AR/IA



Por que se juntar a nós:

  • Trabalhar em aplicativos mobile multiplataforma de ponta
  • Colaborar em um time moderno, ágil e criativo
  • Influenciar a arquitetura e o design de bibliotecas compartilhadas e componentes de UI
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver suas habilidades em desenvolvimento multiplataforma, testes e tecnologias de IA/AR.


Se você é apaixonado(a) por tecnologia, colaboração e desafios internacionais, essa é a sua chance de acelerar sua carreira!



Candidate-se agora e venha desenvolver o futuro com a gente!

title: Coordenador de Order To Cash
description:
Coordenador (a) de Order To Cash | Híbrido - São Paulo


Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de OTC (Order to Cash) . Este profissional será responsável por liderar um time em um momento de transformação, garantindo confiança, autonomia e desenvolvimento da equipe. O papel exige forte capacidade estratégica, mas também disposição para atuar no operacional quando necessário, sendo um verdadeiro backup do time . O desafio principal é gestão de pessoas , com foco em engajamento, crescimento e melhoria contínua dos processos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Gestão e desenvolvimento da equipe , promovendo autonomia e direcionamento.
  • Estruturar processos e implementar melhorias, incluindo planos de contingência.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e estratégica, garantindo suporte operacional quando necessário.
  • Importante conhecer todo processo operacional para gerenciar todo o ciclo Order to Cash , incluindo:
  • Cadastro e registro de clientes (novos e recorrentes).
  • Análise de crédito e definição de condições de pagamento.
  • Faturamento e emissão de boletos (PIX, boleto bancário).
  • Configuração de formas de pagamento no SAP.
  • Conciliação bancária, baixa de recebíveis e títulos.
  • Cálculo de PDD e análise da saúde do contas a receber.
  • Apoiar atividades fiscais e contábeis relacionadas ao processo OTC.
  • Propor e acompanhar KPIs e indicadores para gestão da área.
  • Garantir comunicação eficaz com áreas internas (ex.: força de vendas) e clientes.
  • Participar do fechamento contábil mensal.


Requisitos Técnicos


  • Excel avançado (mandatório).
  • Experiência sólida em processos OTC, análise de crédito, cobrança, contas a receber e faturamento.
  • Conhecimento em SAP (configuração e operação).
  • Noções fiscais e contábeis para interação com áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável: Power BI / Power Query (não prioritário).
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Formação superior completa (desejável pós-graduação).


Competências Comportamentais


  • Perfil autônomo , organizado e proativo.
  • Capacidade de liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas.
  • Comunicação clara e interpessoal positivo.
  • Pensamento estratégico aliado à capacidade de execução.
  • Senso de urgência e habilidade para lidar com desafios.


Diferenciais


  • Experiência em ambientes com crescimento acelerado .
  • Histórico de implementação de melhorias e desenvolvimento de equipes.
  • Espanhol (desejável).

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
Desenvolvedor Java Sênior

Estamos em busca de um Desenvolvedor Java Sênior para atuar em um ambiente bancário robusto, de alta criticidade e grande impacto no negócio. Procuramos alguém que vá além do código: que entenda contexto, risco, performance e segurança — pilares essenciais do setor financeiro.


O desafio

Você fará parte de times estratégicos responsáveis por sistemas core do banco, com alto volume de transações, foco em escalabilidade, resiliência e qualidade técnica. Aqui, decisões técnicas realmente importam.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, evoluir e sustentar aplicações Java de missão crítica
  • Atuar na definição de arquitetura e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Garantir performance, segurança e disponibilidade das aplicações
  • Trabalhar com integrações complexas (APIs, mensageria, sistemas legados)
  • Participar ativamente de code reviews e decisões técnicas
  • Atuar em conjunto com áreas de negócio, arquitetura e segurança da informação


Requisitos técnicos

  • Sólida experiência com Java (21+)
  • Vivência comprovada no segmento bancário ou financeiro
  • Experiência com Spring / Spring Boot
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST, microsserviços e arquitetura distribuída
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais (Oracle, PostgreSQL, SQL Server)
  • Vivência com mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, JMS ou similares)
  • Conhecimentos em CI/CD, versionamento (Git) e práticas DevOps
  • Experiência com sistemas de alta volumetria e baixa latência


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com arquitetura de microsserviços em ambientes bancários
  • Conhecimentos em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  • Vivência com segurança da informação, LGPD e autenticação/autorização
  • Atuação prévia em ambientes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe)


Contratação PJ + benefícios

title: UGC Content Creator (Freelance)
description:
About the Company

We are a fast-growing global mobile app company building digital products used by millions of people worldwide. Our focus is on creating scalable, data-driven consumer applications that combine creativity, technology, and performance marketing.


Role Overview

Produce high-quality 30–60 second short-form videos for TikTok and Instagram, promoting consumer-focused mobile applications to global audiences.

Translate creative briefs into compelling, performance-oriented content while also bringing fresh, original ideas to the table.

Develop powerful hooks, relatable scenarios, and innovative use cases that capture attention within the first seconds.

Continuously research trends, viral formats, and competitor strategies to keep content relevant and competitive.

Collaborate closely with the Marketing team to align content with growth goals, campaign strategy, and performance metrics.

Share learnings and creative suggestions that help improve overall content strategy, engagement rates, and conversion performance.


Candidate Profile

Strong interest in TikTok, Instagram Reels, and short-form content ecosystems.

Ability to create engaging, high-retention videos that align with platform trends (portfolio or sample work is highly preferred).

Strong creative instinct with the ability to turn everyday concepts into attention-grabbing content.

Confidence on camera — or strong storytelling ability without appearing on camera.

Understanding of audience behavior, content psychology, and the importance of the first 3 seconds.

Self-driven and organized, capable of managing freelance deliverables independently.

Comfortable working in a fast-paced, feedback-driven environment.

English proficiency is a plus, as content targets an international audience.


Compensation

Per-Video Payment Model: You’ll receive compensation for each completed and approved video, with ongoing project opportunities based on performance

title: MES Developer
description:
MES Developer

Brazil/Argentina

Contract


Key Accountabilities:

  • This role will provide you with the opportunity to lead key activities to make progress in your career, these responsibilities include some of the following:
  • Participate in requirements gathering to solidify requirements and determine the best technical solution to meet the business needs.
  • Develop and implement new templates, components, and responsive web pages/sites and support client development and security standards while developing.
  • Work in the Manufacturing organization on the implementation of new capabilities.
  • Carry out the development of the assigned project adhering to the engineering standards/best practices, committing to the agreed timeline, and ensures quality metrics are met.
  • Integrate internal and/or external applications/ERP using middleware.


Key Qualifications and Experience

We are seeking an experienced Developer with strong expertise in GE Plant Applications to design, develop, enhance, and support Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solutions. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with SQL, .NET technologies, and Web Services, and will work closely with manufacturing, quality, and other cross-functional teams to deliver reliable and scalable design to enhance current MES/Quality solutions that support shop-floor operations.

  • Strong hands-on experience with GE Plant Applications.
  • Proficiency in writing Stored procedure, Functions and other SQL Server related codes. (T-SQL, performance tuning, database design)
  • Experience with .NET technologies (C#, ASP.NET, Web API, Windows Services)
  • Solid understanding of Web Services (REST and/or SOAP)
  • Experience with UI design – HTML/Thingworx/ReactJS
  • Strong hands-on experience with reporting capabilities – SSRS/PBI and others.
  • Experience integrating MES with ERP systems (SAP preferred)
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes and shop-floor systems
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently and in cross-functional teams
  • Experience designing and optimizing relational databases and stored procedures for optimal performance and/or maintainability.
  • Experience with version control systems (Azure DevOps preferably)
  • Exposure to Agile/Scrum development methodologies.

title: Software Application Engineer
description:
***Please send your CV in English


About Foretellix:

Foretellix is the gold standard for data-driven autonomy development toolchains. Foretellix’s Foretify™ toolchain enables a measurable, efficient, and trusted path to safe and scalable autonomy that helps you launch with confidence. Building on its industry leading V&V technology, Foretellix is enabling the AI autonomy revolution.


Role Description:

Be part of the Application Engineering Team responsible for adapting and deploying Foretellix verification & validation solutions to our customers and making them successful at their mission to provide next-gen ADAS/AV products. Our Application Engineers have a unique mix of ADAS/AV domain knowledge, software expertise, creativity, and the ability to work closely with customers to maximize the impact our solution can have on their ability to deliver high quality, safe products.


What will you do:

  • Deploy the Foretellix solution at customer accounts. From tools installation and integration, customer training and ramp-up, to defining the V&V strategy, including both remote and on-site support.
  • Shape our products by being the primary point of contact between the customer and R&D. Understand the customer’s V&V challenges and translate them into product requirements to help improve the products.
  • Work with the sales team as the technical product expert to develop and deliver demos and presentations to customers, as well as guide and support customer product evaluations.
  • When required, create application notes, methodology documents, technical presentations and customer trainings.


Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of industry working experience, ideally in the ADAS/AV domain.
  • Knowledge in Software Engineering, including OO programming, testing, and debugging.
  • BSc or above in the areas of Computer Science, Automotive Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or other related fields.
  • Have excellent human relationship skills
  • Be communicative and fluent in English, both verbal and in writing.
  • Be a team-player, resourceful, and professional.


Advantages:

title: Desenvolvedor Tasy
description:
Curte unir tecnologia, saúde e impacto real na vida das pessoas? Como Consultor Desenvolvedor Tasy EMR, você será peça-chave na evolução de soluções para hospitais e clínicas, ajudando a transformar a jornada de cuidado em algo mais ágil, seguro e inteligente.

Você vai atuar em uma empresa focada em inovação em saúde, com times multidisciplinares, ambiente colaborativo e espaço para propor melhorias de verdade.

  • Desenvolver, parametrizar e customizar módulos no Tasy EMR.
  • Levantar requisitos com áreas de negócio e traduzir em soluções técnicas.
  • Construir integrações (interfaces) entre Tasy e outros sistemas.
  • Realizar testes, homologação e suporte pós-implantação.
  • Documentar soluções, fluxos e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar usuários-chave em treinamentos e dúvidas.
  • Sugerir melhorias contínuas em processos e sistemas.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência comprovada com Tasy EMR (desenvolvimento, parametrização ou consultoria).
  • Vivência em ambiente hospitalar ou de saúde suplementar.
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados (SQL) para consultas e ajustes.
  • Experiência com análise de requisitos e desenho de processos.
  • Capacidade de comunicação clara com áreas técnicas e de negócio.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com integrações HL7, webservices, APIs ou ESB.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos de implantação ou migração de Tasy.
  • Noções de metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Conhecimento em outros sistemas de gestão hospitalar/EMR.
  • Formação em TI, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação, Saúde ou áreas correlatas.

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Job Summary

We are seeking a Key Account Manager to manage, nurture, and grow existing client relationships with HBX Group. This role is essential in ensuring client satisfaction, driving account performance, and identifying opportunities for incremental growth. You will be responsible for client onboarding, operational optimization, and ongoing engagement, while collaborating cross-functionally to deliver a seamless and impactful customer experience.


Key Responsibilities

Client Relationship Management

  • Maintain and strengthen relationships with assigned key accounts.
  • Conduct regular client meetings, monthly performance reviews, and reporting.
  • Serve as the main point of contact, ensuring timely resolution of issues and alignment with client goals.


Account Activation & Optimization

  • Understand client operations across departments (e.g., tech, pricing, mapping).
  • Support onboarding of new products and services using Salesforce and Salesloft.
  • Monitor account performance and implement optimization strategies for distribution and pricing.


Growth & Retention

  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities based on client needs and market trends.
  • Build rapport across various levels of the client’s organization.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure delivery of client-specific solutions and improvements.


Required Skills

  • Strong relationship-building and account management capabilities.
  • Commercial acumen and consultative selling approach.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and influencing skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data and drive decisions.
  • Proactive, customer-focused, and results-oriented.


Required Tech Skills

  • Proficiency in Salesforce, Salesloft, and BI tools (e.g., Tableau).
  • Strong command of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Basic understanding of API functionality and travel tech platforms.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 5+ years in account management, sales, or client services.
  • Fluent in English and source market language (essential).
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% for client visits and meetings.
  • Experience in matrixed organizations and tech-enabled environments.
  • Background in travel, financial services, or related industries is a plus.


At HBX Group, we believe that diversity drives innovation and makes travel a force for good. We're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected, embracing different backgrounds, perspectives and talents. Join us and be part of a team where diversity and equal opportunities really do make a difference.

title: Engenheiro de Software Sênior (Remoto)
description:
Ola!


A Aggrandize nasceu em 2015 com a missão de engrandecer pessoas e negócios . Guiados por valores como adaptabilidade, colaboração, foco no cliente e visão de dono, oferecemos soluções que transformam desafios em oportunidades.


Somos especialistas em Platform Engineering , Data Analytics , Modern Applications e Cybersecurity , sempre com o compromisso de impulsionar o crescimento e a inovação de nossos parceiros.


Nosso trabalho é mais do que tecnologia; é sobre potencializar resultados. Increase the power of your business .


Agora que você conhece a cultura Aggrandize, saiba mais sobre a oportunidade:


Estamos em busca de um (a) Engenheiro (a) de Software com IA para projetar, desenvolver e evoluir soluções que utilizam Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning, atuando de ponta a ponta, da concepção técnica até a implementação em produção.

Essa pessoa trabalhará em conjunto com times de produto, dados e negócios para transformar desafios reais em soluções escaláveis, seguras e de alto impacto.


❇️ O seu papel no time:

  • Projetar e desenvolver aplicações de software que incorporem modelos de IA e Machine Learning;
  • Integrar modelos de IA a sistemas existentes, APIs, pipelines de dados e arquiteturas distribuídas;
  • Colaborar com cientistas de dados e engenheiros de dados na construção, treinamento, versionamento e deploy de modelos;
  • Implementar práticas de MLOps, garantindo automação, monitoramento, rastreabilidade e escalabilidade dos modelos em produção;
  • Desenvolver soluções baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models) como chatbots, sistemas de recomendação, classificação, busca semântica e automação inteligente;
  • Garantir qualidade de código, segurança, performance e boas práticas de engenharia de software;
  • Participar de decisões de arquitetura, revisões técnicas e definição de padrões;
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua das soluções, avaliando métricas de performance dos modelos e do software;
  • Documentar soluções técnicas e compartilhar conhecimento com o time.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Hard Skills:

  • Sólida experiência em engenharia de software (backend e/ou full stack);
  • Proficiência em linguagens como Python, Java, Go, JavaScript ou TypeScript;
  • Experiência com frameworks e bibliotecas de IA e Machine Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, LangChain ou Hugging Face);
  • Conhecimento em APIs, microserviços e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos;
  • Experiência com cloud computing (Google Cloud ou Azure);
  • Familiaridade com containers e orquestração (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git) e práticas de CI/CD.


❇️ Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prática com LLMs, GenAI, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e fine-tuning de modelos;
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de dados como Databricks, BigQuery ou Spark;
  • Experiência com MLOps (MLflow, Kubeflow ou Vertex AI);
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta escala ou sistemas críticos;
  • Conhecimento em segurança aplicada à IA e governança de dados;
  • Experiência prévia em produtos digitais orientados a dados.


❇️ O que esperamos de você - Soft Skills:

  • Adaptabilidade;
  • Colaboração;
  • Visão de dono;

description:

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Atuar com desenvolvimento de software usando principalmente a tecnologia Java/Springboot.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver, testar e manter APIs e serviços backend de alta qualidade e eficiência, utilizando Java e SpringBoot.
  • Colaborar com times de frontend e outros stakeholders para garantir que as entregas atendam aos requisitos de negócio e técnicos.
  • Documentar as soluções e práticas adotadas no desenvolvimento.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento backend com Java.
  • Conhecimento do framework SpringBoot e suas principais bibliotecas e módulos (Spring Data, Spring Security, Spring MVC, etc).
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados relacionais (ex: PostgreSQL, MySQL) e noSQL (ex: MongoDB, Redis).
  • Experiência com integração de APIs RESTful.
  • Experiência com controle de versão, preferencialmente Git.



Você pode se destacar se:

  • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de CI/CD (ex: Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Conhecimento em arquiteturas de microsserviços e em servidores de aplicação leve.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico;
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Atuar com desenvolvimento de software usando principalmente a tecnologia Java/Springboot.

title: Semi Senior Java Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Semi Senior Java Developer position focuses on developing and optimizing complex applications using advanced Java skills. This role involves enhancing system performance, implementing sophisticated features, leading smaller project teams or modules, and mentoring junior developers while playing a crucial part in development projects and ensuring timely delivery of high-quality solutions.


Key responsibilities


- Designing and developing complex Java applications, demonstrating strong problem-solving capabilities and technical expertise.

- Leading smaller project teams or modules, guiding junior developers and ensuring project timelines and coding standards are met.

- Conducting thorough code reviews, enforcing best practices for high-quality, maintainable code across the team.

- Staying updated with advanced Java features and frameworks while mentoring junior team members in their professional development.

- Collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, translating technical and business requirements into robust, scalable solutions.

- Contributing significantly to project planning and execution, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business objectives.


Requirements


- Java Expertise: 3+ years of hands-on experience with Java development.

- APIs and Web Services: Proven experience designing and implementing APIs and Web Services.

- Database Technologies: Practical experience with database systems and data management.

- Algorithm Knowledge: Advanced understanding of algorithms and data structures.

- Infrastructure Basics: Basic IT infrastructure knowledge and deployment practices.

- Software Design: Experience in designing and implementing software modules for real-world applications.

- Testing Proficiency: Proficient in writing and implementing unit tests.

- CI/CD Familiarity: Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation.



Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Contract Clinical Research Associate
description:
Location: Brazil (remote)

Type: 12-month contract - attractive hourly compensation.


About Clinergy

Clinergy Health is a boutique CRO focused on delivering high-quality, highly tailored clinical development solutions for pharmaceutical and biotech companies.


We intentionally work with a small number of strategic projects, spanning Phase I to Real-World Evidence, to ensure scientific rigor, operational excellence, and true partnership with our clients.


Role Description

We are looking for a Contract Clinical Research Associate. The Clinical Research Associate will oversee and monitor assigned clinical trials, ensuring compliance with protocols and regulatory requirements. Key responsibilities may include site assessment selection, initiation, and management, coordinating clinical operations, assisting with protocol implementation, and ensuring accurate study documentation. The role involves frequent collaboration with cross-functional teams and adherence to quality standards to meet project timelines.


Activities

  • Support and conduct preparation activities for Site Initiation Visits;
  • Conduct independent monitoring to verify accuracy of study data vs. source records;
  • Ensure requirements for patient privacy are met;
  • Generate and collect study documentation such as consent forms, Essential Documents, Case Report Forms and Investigator Agreements;
  • Conduct and tracks progress of site activities to initiation, enrolment and screening, interim monitoring and close out requirements;
  • Ensure no study tasks are conducted prior to IRB/EC approval and formal site activation;
  • Review Serious Adverse Event (SAE) narratives with sites and medical monitor; Ensure adverse event reporting is done in accordance with regulatory requirements;
  • Organize, conduct and report on Site Qualification, Site Initiation, Interim Monitoring, and Close-out visits;
  • Verify the accuracy of study results;
  • Identify and resolve site issues;


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences;
  • 2+ years experience as a CRA on pharma or CRO companies(Mandatory);
  • Advanced/Fluent in English;
  • Strong medical and clinical knowledge of indications, therapies, and patient population
  • Proven track record of having good sponsor, investigator, site, and vendor relations
  • Strong computer skills including EDC system experience
  • Demonstrated detailed knowledge of guidelines, systems for clinical trial management and of ICH GCP and international regulations and practices


Skills

  • Self driven individual
  • Sense of urgency
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
  • Attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Good problem solving skills
  • Enthusiastic and energetic


To apply for this opportunity please send your updated CV to


Note: Candidates who do not possess the mandatory requirements specified above will not be considered.

title: Senior Golang Engineer
description:
Please note that the project operates in the UK time zone.


We are seeking a dedicated, motivated, and reliable Senior Golang Engineer who is interested in providing innovative software solutions for our clients. Be a part of our team as we continue to deliver high quality products and services. The Senior Go Engineer will be responsible for building backend services in Go in EKS, as well as some Lambdas. The overall project will be centered around providing product data and managing the product life cycle. If you are an open communicator with a passion for learning, love to think outside the box and you are excited about software development, we are looking for you!


RESPONSIBILITIES

• Use your deep expertise in Go and related technologies to develop high-quality, scalable, maintainable software solutions.

• Make technically sound decisions and champion high standards of coding and architecture best practices.

• Develop and maintain software documentation such as technical specifications and design documents.

• Continually enhance the team’s performance by mentoring, code reviews, and improving current processes in the SDLC.

• Troubleshoot and debug software issues as they arise.

• Collaborate within a cross functional team and be able to transform both functional and non-functional requirements into actionable work.

• Manage communication of progress/status to stakeholders.


WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• At least 4 years of professional software development experience.

• Proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, semantics, database connectivity, and object-oriented concepts.

• Strong understanding of data structures and algorithms.

• Experience working with Go frameworks such as Gin, Revel, Echo, Beego, etc.

• Strong understanding of web services (HTTP, SOAP, REST, GQL, etc.).

• Terraform, Lambdas, Writing API’s.

• Strong working knowledge of relational databases.

• Experience in troubleshooting issues and root cause analysis.

• A proven track record of delivering high quality and tested software on-time and often.

• An open mind, and the patience to explain issues in a constructive manner.

• Strong communication skills, with at least an intermediate level of English.

• Experience working in distributed, cross functional teams.


NICE TO HAVE

• Kubernetes or EKS.

• Algolia.

• Shopify.

• DynamoDB


Who We Are?

We are a fast growing business and technology consultant company co-founded in 2019. We offer a custom-tailored, white-glove engineering service fit for our clients, because a digital transformation is more than just technology. With a successful track record of being a preferred vendor for Fortune 500 companies and as a trusted partner for some of the industry’s leading companies, our global talent has helped many clients achieve their goals.


What's In It For You

  • We offer 100% remote work
  • Wellness/Fitness package
  • Paid trainings and certifications
  • 22 days of paid leave (27 days in the second year with us)
  • Professional Conferences and Training
  • Global Team Building Activities
  • Access to co-working spaces worldwide


Your applications and referrals are welcome!

title: SAP S/4 HANA BRIM Application Expert (Experto en aplicaciones SAP S/4 HANA BRIM)
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE

Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.


KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams.
  • Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
  • Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
  • Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
  • Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


Desirable:

  • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
  • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
  • Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.
  • Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.


WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.


We are the ASSA ABLOY Group

Our people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access.


As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.


As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: SAP S/4 HANA BRIM Application Expert (Experto en aplicaciones SAP S/4 HANA BRIM)
description:
ASSA ABLOY Global Solutions is rolling out SAP S/4 HANA across the Division which will enable and support its business expansion strategy in line with the new operating business model.


PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE

Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.


KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams.
  • Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
  • Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
  • Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
  • Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


Desirable:

  • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
  • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
  • Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.
  • Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.


WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.

title: Senior Content Manager
description:
As a Senior Content Manager, you will play a key role in supporting MoveUp Media’s growth by owning the operational and strategic execution of content across our website portfolio. You will take ownership of content performance and strategy across our websites, while leading day-to-day content operations and working closely with SEO and cross-functional teams. You will be responsible for turning content and SEO strategies into measurable results, while ensuring high-quality standards across multi-language teams and markets.


This role contributes directly to the CORE department’s objectives by supporting the growth, stability, and diversification of the business through content performance, strong processes, and effective collaboration. You will act as the main point of ownership for content quality and delivery, working closely with SEO, Product, and cross-functional teams.


To be more specific, you will:


  • Lead and develop the content strategy for our flagship, multi-language websites across multiple markets
  • Manage content workflows and ensure consistent, high-quality output across all sites
  • Oversee content quality, structure, and standards across our portfolio
  • Work proactively with content teams to define and implement content checklists and best practices
  • Collaborate closely with SEO, Tech, Design, and Product teams to ensure content and SEO best practices are followed
  • Ensure all SEO and content checks are completed ahead of website launches or redesigns
  • Regularly review websites to identify issues, suggest improvements, and support teams with implementation
  • Monitor content performance and report progress and key initiatives to senior stakeholders
  • Ensure content meets compliance and regulatory requirements and oversee necessary updates
  • Stay up to date with market trends, best practices, and iGaming innovations
  • Support hiring and team development (mentoring) in collaboration with Talent Acquisition and HR.


The ideal profile


We’re looking for a Senior Content Manager ready to step into a Lead role — someone who takes ownership of content performance, works independently, and collaborates closely with SEO to drive results.


You are someone who:


  • Has 3+ years of experience in a senior content or content leadership role
  • Has iGaming experience (a strong plus, not a must)
  • Has a background in journalism, communications, or a related field (a plus)
  • Has an excellent command of English and a strong eye for content quality and consistency
  • Is comfortable reviewing and optimising content rather than writing it


You bring strong CM fundamentals:


  • High level of autonomy and strong task prioritisation skills
  • Ownership mindset over site and content performance
  • Ability to analyse performance data and turn insights into clear actions
  • Strategic thinking and the ability to plan toward defined goals
  • Experience working with CMS platforms


You work well with others and think ahead:


  • Collaborative approach, especially when working with SEO teams
  • Proactive in sharing ideas, flagging issues, and suggesting improvements
  • Open to experimentation, innovation, and continuous improvement
  • Positive attitude with a growth mindset and leadership potential


Feeling up to the task of managing the main challenges of the role, even without meeting all criteria? We're eager to hear from you! We know not all great candidates will match 100% of the above.


Next steps in the process ✅


  • 1rst Interview with your future manager to make sure you meet the role’s requirements
  • 2nd interview with HR to better understand who you are and make sure there is a cultural fit with MoveUp Media
  • Last step: a proposition for us to start working together!


What’s in it for you


  • A full time remote work environment.
  • A flexible schedule and paid time off. We measure results , not hours.
  • Competitive salary, depending on your level of seniority in the role and your location
  • Development opportunities. As a startup with rapid growth, there are a lot of possibilities that can arise and we are committed to accompany our team members in their career path.
  • Yearly get together with the team to connect, work and have fun . We strive to find good spots for everyone to enjoy the stay!


MoveUp Media

description:

Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga:

Analista BI - Remoto.


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas; - Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar dessa posição:

Atuação no desenvolvimento e melhorias de sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

  • Proficiência em SQL , com capacidade de realizar consultas complexas
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Business Intelligence (Power BI, Tableau ou similares)
  • Habilidade na criação de relatórios e dashboards gerenciais
  • Conhecimento em análise estatística e testes de hipóteses
  • Capacidade de traduzir dados em insights acionáveis para o negócio

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. title: Desenvolvimento .NET AWS Sênior
description:
Já conhece a GFT?

Com mais de 40 anos de mercado e localizada em 20 países, a GFT emprega mais de 12.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo quase 5.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

Promovemos uma cultura de desenvolvimento e crescimento pautadas no nosso pilar de Continuous Scaled Learning porque acreditamos o uso inteligente da tecnologia é a chave para o sucesso nesse mundo digital.


O que buscamos:

Profissional de nível Sênior que atue com .NET e AWS.


Requisitos e Qualificações:


  • NET Core, AWS;
  • Conceitos de microserviços e aplicações distribuídas;
  • Testes unitários;
  • Conhecimento em REST APIs;
  • Docker, Kubernetes;
  • Desenvolvimento em Cloud AWS;
  • RDS MySQL e DynamoDB, AWS Lambda utilizando Python, ECS Fargate, Elastic Cache Redis, API Gateway, EventBridge, Secrets Manager, KMS, etc;
  • SQL (SQL Server ou MySQL) e DynamoDB;
  • Serviço de Mensageria: KAFTA;
  • Experiência em CI/CD (CodeCommit, CodePipeline, CodeBuild);
  • Conhecimento dos conceitos: Ágil, DevOps e Lean.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;
  • Transforme ideias em soluções criativas e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;
  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.


O que oferecemos:

  • Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;
  • Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;
  • Programas de incentivo à Certificações;
  • Horário de trabalho flexível;
  • Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;
  • Salários competitivos;
  • Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;
  • Gympass;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Auxílio-Creche;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Seguro de Vida.



Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.

title: Desenvolvedor de .NET sênior
description:
Na InvoiSys, estamos evoluindo de uma arquitetura tradicional para uma plataforma moderna, escalável e orientada a eventos.

Buscamos um(a) Senior Software Engineer com forte viés arquitetural para atuar diretamente na construção dessa nova fundação.


Você não vai apenas desenvolver — vai ajudar a decidir como a empresa constrói software daqui pra frente.


Responsabilidades:

· Evoluir sistemas em .NET com foco em escalabilidade e qualidade;

· Participar do desenho da nova arquitetura da plataforma;

· Definir padrões de comunicação entre serviços (eventos, APIs, contratos);

· Apoiar decisões sobre:

  • microsserviços vs modular monolith
  • event-driven architecture
  • mensageria

· Melhorar observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing) ;

· Garantir boas práticas (testes, CI/CD, versionamento) ;

· Atuar como referência técnica para o time.

title: Python Developer
description:
A Jusfy está em busca de um Python Developer para compor o time! Somos uma startup jurídica que busca constantemente soluções para facilitar a vida dos advogados e advogadas brasileiros. Atuamos na área de tecnologia, desenvolvendo produtos e ferramentas que auxiliam na produtividade diária dos nossos clientes.

Somos uma empresa jovem e muito promissora. Alcançamos resultados expressivos de crescimento nos últimos anos e sabemos que temos ainda muito mais para conquistar. Buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte dessa trajetória junto conosco!


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter web crawlers e scrapers
  • Identificar e resolver problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade com crawling distribuído em escala.
  • Escrever códigos limpos, de alta qualidade e fácil manutenção seguindo as boas práticas de desenvolvimento;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes de produto, design e operações para definir requisitos e entregar soluções eficazes;
  • Participar ativamente em discussões de arquitetura e tecnologias;
  • Realizar code reviews, ajudando outros desenvolvedores a melhorar a qualidade do código;
  • Garantir que a documentação do código e arquitetura esteja sempre atualizada.


Requisitos:

  • Sólida experiência com Python 3;
  • Conhecimentos protocolos web, como HTTP/HTTPS;
  • Experiência prática com scraping e crawling (ex: requests, BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, Playwright, Selenium, etc.);
  • Experiência com HTML e JavaScript;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não-relacionais;
  • Orquestração de containers (Docker e docker-compose);
  • Experiência com controle de versão utilizando Git;
  • Conhecimento de cloud AWS.
  • Boa habilidade de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico;


Desejável:

  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Prática em Domain-Driven Design (DDD) e Clean Architecture;
  • Conhecimento de Redes de computadores;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de CI/CD utilizando github actions;
  • Experiência em times de desenvolvimento de software ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Conhecimento em testes automatizados e ferramentas de integração contínua;
  • Conhecimento de Design Patterns;


Modelo de Contratação: PJ


Oferecemos:

  • Cartão flexível de benefícios;
  • Bônus (Participação nos Resultados);
  • Day Off de aniversário;
  • Descanso remunerado;

title: PI Developer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Insight Global is looking to hire a remote PI Developer working central hours. We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Junior PI Developer to join our team working on an Oil and Gas compressor project. The successful candidate will assist in the development, implementation, and maintenance of PI systems to ensure efficient data collection, analysis, and reporting. This role is crucial for optimizing compressor performance and ensuring operational excellence.




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience: 0-2 years of experience in PI system development or a related field.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in PI System software (PI Server, PI AF, PI Vision, etc.).
  • Basic understanding of data integration and ETL processes.
  • Familiarity with programming languages such as Python, SQL, or similar.

title: Especialista em Branding
description:
Olá, somos a SuperFrete :)


Queremos ser a maior e mais amada rede de logística digital, quer fazer parte disso?

Somos uma startup que atua no segmento do varejo e logística, apoiando os pequenos e médios empreendedores a se tornarem mais competitivos no mercado e a alavancarem suas vendas. Por isso, buscamos um Super Especialista em Branding , que se identifique com o nosso propósito, que tenha muita energia para somar no time de Marketing e que queira crescer (muito!) com a gente.



Responsabilidades


  • Liderar e apoiar o desenvolvimento do Brand System da SuperFrete (brandbook, tom de voz, diretrizes visuais e narrativas, em todos os canais da marca incluindo redes sociais, endomarketing e assessoria de imprensa);
  • Garantir a consistência da identidade da marca em todos os pontos de contato;
  • Criar guidelines, playbooks e briefings estratégicos para campanhas e conteúdos;
  • Acompanhar cronogramas, entregas e qualidade das iniciativas de branding;
  • Conduzir análises de mercado, auditorias de marca e acompanhamento de indicadores de branding;
  • Criar e conduzir workshops de marca para equipes internas e novas lideranças;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com diferentes áreas e squads para garantir a aplicação correta das diretrizes da marca;
  • Conduzir a evolução do posicionamento da marca, identificando oportunidades no ecossistema de e-commerce, logística e empreendedorismo;
  • Liderar iniciativas estratégicas de branding e gerenciar relacionamento com agências, consultorias e parceiros criativos;
  • Planejar a presença da marca em eventos do setor, garantindo experiências alinhadas ao posicionamento da SuperFrete;
  • Contribuir para o fortalecimento da cultura de marca e marca empregadora dentro da organização.
  • Liderar a estratégia de PR e relacionamento com imprensa, identificando oportunidades de exposição institucional da marca.



Requisitos


  • Ensino superior completo em Publicidade e Propaganda, Jornalismo, Marketing ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência na gestão e aplicação de Brand Systems (brandbook, diretrizes visuais e tom de voz);
  • Conhecimento em pesquisas de marca, análise de mercado e concorrência;
  • Experiência em projetos de branding ou rebranding;
  • Capacidade de definir, planejar e executar estratégias de marca;
  • Habilidade para identificar tendências de mercado e comportamento do consumidor;
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de storytelling e excelente habilidade de escrita;
  • Capacidade de transitar entre diferentes contextos, projetos e stakeholders;
  • Olhar crítico para identidade visual e revisão de peças (texto e design);
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplos projetos e iniciativas de marca simultaneamente.



Diferenciais


  • Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos, como startups ou empresas em processo de expansão;
  • Experiência com produção de eventos corporativos;
  • Experiência com assessoria de imprensa.



O que você pode esperar dos Supers?


  • Uma cultura de muita confiança, colaboração, focada em resultados, com muita autonomia e transparência;
  • Buscamos excelência em tudo o que fazemos, por isso estamos sempre aprendendo;
  • Temos vontade de construir junto, fazer a diferença e gerar impacto.



O que oferecemos:

title: [Tech] Especialista de Banco de Dados - PostgreSQL
description:
Atuação em atividades de N2 e N3 de sustentação de ambientes de banco dedados PostgreSQL, Oracle e MySQL.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Sustentar e aprimorar a segurança, integridade, disponibilidade e performance dos bancos de dados;
  • Administrar políticas de backup e executar testes de recuperação de desastres;
  • Evoluir e acompanhar o monitoramento de banco de dados, para prevenção de falhas e otimização de desempenho;
  • Prover sustentação técnica, executar procedimentos de gestão de mudanças e resolver problemas, focando na causa raiz dos incidentes;
  • Conduzir análises detalhadas após incidentes para implementar melhorias contínuas;
  • Pesquisar e implementar novas tecnologias e rotinas para automação e otimização dos ambientes de banco de dados;
  • Conduzir migrações de ambientes complexos, garantindo sua plena funcionalidade e menor downtime;
  • Mentorar e transferir conhecimentos para os membros do time;
  • Desenvolver procedimentos operacionais baseados em pesquisas de melhores práticas e definições internas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência e conhecimento avançado em administração de banco de dados PostgreSQL;
  • Experiência e conhecimento intermediário em administração de banco de dados Oracle;
  • Experiência e conhecimento intermediário em administração de banco de dados MySQL;
  • Experiência e conhecimento avançado em administração de ambientes de banco de dados com sistema Operacional Linux;
  • Experiência e conhecimento básico em Kubernetes.

title: Business Development Manager (FX/CFD)
description:
D Prime is a globally recognized online broker, empowering professional investors with access to multi-asset CFD trading across global markets. With operational hubs in Dallas, London, Sydney, Singapore, Hong Kong, and Dubai, we combine advanced technology with deep industry expertise to deliver a seamless trading experience. We operate under multiple reputable financial licenses, including regulation by the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), US SEC and FINRA, Australia’s ASIC, as well as authorities in Seychelles, Mauritius, and Vanuatu, ensuring strong compliance, transparency, and investor protection worldwide.


We are looking for a proactive and results-oriented Business Development Manager who will be responsible for expanding our client base, strengthening partnerships, and promoting our trading solutions across markets. This role requires strong knowledge of the online trading industry and the ability to convert opportunities into long-term business relationships.


Key Responsibilities


  • Develop new and existing markets and client base, promote our trading solutions
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, IBs, and affiliates
  • Identify client trading needs and propose suitable brokerage services, platforms, and solutions
  • Effectively communicate the company’s value proposition, trading conditions, platforms, and partnership programs
  • Research sales statistics and assess growth opportunities within target markets
  • Maintain accurate records of leads, partners, and clients within the CRM system
  • Coordinate with internal departments (Dealing, Compliance, Marketing, Support) to ensure high service standards and client satisfaction
  • Conduct presentations, webinars, and platform demonstrations to prospective clients and partners


Key Requirements


  • Proven experience in Business Development / Sales within a CFD / Forex Brokerage
  • Strong understanding of FX, CFDs, trading platforms (e.g., MT4/MT5), and brokerage operations
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Experience working with CRM systems and managing sales pipelines
  • Existing network of traders, IBs, or affiliates is a strong advantage
  • Ability to analyze market trends and identify revenue opportunities
  • Target-driven mindset with experience working toward KPIs and revenue goals
  • Willingness to travel for partner meetings, expos, and industry events


What We Offer


  • Competitive base salary & performance-based incentives and bonuses
  • Opportunity to influence regional partnership and client acquisition strategies
  • Career progression within a well-established Forex Brokerage environment
  • Exposure to global financial markets and advanced trading technologies
  • Flexible working arrangement


If you’re a results-driven business development professional with industry experience and a passion for building strong client and partner relationships, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sênior
description:
Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sênior


Local: Fazenda Brasileiro – Teofilândia (BA), Brasil

Quantidade de Vagas: 01

Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial

Disponibilidade: Mudança para a região (empresa oferece suporte)


Sobre a Oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Ventilação Sênior para atuar na mina subterrânea , sendo responsável pelo planejamento estratégico e gestão do sistema de ventilação , bem como pelo acompanhamento de sua execução junto à equipe de Infraestrutura, assegurando condições adequadas de qualidade do ar, segurança operacional, conformidade legal e suporte eficiente às atividades de lavra e desenvolvimento da mina.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Definir a estratégia de ventilação da mina subterrânea, garantindo alinhamento ao plano de negócios, à segurança dos trabalhadores e à sustentabilidade da operação;
  • Desenvolver e revisar projetos de ventilação para mina subterrânea (primária e secundária);
  • Realizar estudos de fluxo de ar, controle de gases, poeiras, temperatura e umidade;
  • Dimensionar ventiladores principais e auxiliares, dutos, portas e reguladores de ventilação;
  • Elaborar e manter atualizados os planos de ventilação da mina;
  • Propor e implementar inovações, melhorias tecnológicas e iniciativas de otimização de custos nos sistemas de ventilação, visando ganhos de produtividade, segurança e sustentabilidade;
  • Analisar riscos críticos relacionados à ventilação, gases, particulados e condições ambientais, apoiando a gestão de riscos operacionais e a tomada de decisão estratégica;
  • Atuar de forma integrada com geologia, planejamento de mina, produção, manutenção e SSMA;
  • Liderar estudos avançados de ventilação e projetos associados à expansão, aprofundamento ou mudanças de layout da mina, viabilizando tecnicamente novos cenários operacionais com segurança e eficiência.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Formação Completa em Engenharia;
  • Experiência sólida em ventilação de minas subterrâneas;
  • Vivência com softwares de ventilação (ex.: Ventsim, VentSim Design, VUMA ou similares);
  • Disponibilidade de mudança para Teofilândia, BA;
  • Pós-graduação ou especialização em Ventilação de Minas, Segurança do Trabalho (desejável).


Se você tem interesse em ventilação de mina subterrânea, planejamento e controle da qualidade do ar, atuação em campo e liderança de equipes em um ambiente operacional dinâmico, essa vaga pode ser para você!

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.

Avenue Code has been believing in and promoting plurality actions for over 10 years, understanding that recognizing differences and fostering a safe environment, employment opportunities, representation, and support are the best ways to promote an increasingly equitable culture.



About the opportunity:

  • Please prioritize senior-level Data/MLOps Engineers with strong coding ability and clear communication. Candidates must be able to clearly explain their approach, design decisions, trade offs, and alternatives, and articulate end-to-end MLOps architecture. Candidates with average coding skills or limited ability to communicate ideas will not be considered.


Data Engineer (MLOps Focus)Team & Scope

  • The team owns the entire data pipeline , from ingestion to downstream consumption.
  • Data Engineering and MLOps responsibilities are combined , and the team supports multiple projects simultaneously.
  • This is primarily a Data Engineering role , with strong exposure to MLOps and ML integration .

Technical Focus

  • The team writes significantly less SQL compared to a typical Data Engineering team.
  • There is a large Business Analyst team responsible for providing raw data and writing most of the SQL.
  • Candidates must be comfortable with SQL , but in day to day work, SQL usage is limited.
  • Strong programming and system design skills are critical, similar to a traditional Software Engineering role.
  • Python is the main programming language, but strong experience in Java or Scala is also acceptable.
  • The ideal profile is a generalist , not a specialist.
  • Key expectations include:
  • Writing production grade code
  • Designing scalable systems
  • Orchestrating end to end data and ML pipelines
  • Integrating ML models into broader systems
  • SQL is considered an additional skill , not the core focus.





Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

Candidates with average coding skills or limited ability to communicate ideas will not be considered.


Data Engineer (MLOps Focus)Team & Scope

  • The team owns the entire data pipeline , from ingestion to downstream consumption.
  • Data Engineering and MLOps responsibilities are combined , and the team supports multiple projects simultaneously.
  • This is primarily a Data Engineering role , with strong exposure to MLOps and ML integration .

Technical Focus

  • The team writes significantly less SQL compared to a typical Data Engineering team.
  • There is a large Business Analyst team responsible for providing raw data and writing most of the SQL.
  • Candidates must be comfortable with SQL , but in day to day work, SQL usage is limited.
  • Strong programming and system design skills are critical, similar to a traditional Software Engineering role.
  • Python is the main programming language, but strong experience in Java or Scala is also acceptable.
  • The ideal profile is a generalist , not a specialist.
  • Key expectations include:
  • Writing production grade code
  • Designing scalable systems
  • Orchestrating end to end data and ML pipelines
  • Integrating ML models into broader systems
  • SQL is considered an additional skill , not the core focus.





Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, high-performance full stack applications with a strong emphasis on backend architecture.
  • Lead and contribute to the integration of AI/ML features into products, collaborating closely with data scientists and engineers.
  • Develop robust backend services and APIs using Python or Node.js (Express, NestJS) .
  • Contribute to frontend development using React and modern JavaScript/TypeScript practices.
  • Identify, prioritize, and execute tasks throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Debug, optimize, and maintain backend systems, APIs, and data workflows.
  • Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and best engineering practices.
  • Document development phases, monitor system performance, and improve reliability.
  • Participate in Scrum meetings and contribute to product and technical decision-making.


Qualifications

  • Higher education in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on Artificial Intelligence and/or Machine Learning
  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • 4+ years of professional software development experience, with strong backend expertise in Python and/or Node.js.
  • Proficiency with frontend technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/AI models into production environments.
  • Familiarity with database technologies such as MySQL, MongoDB, or PostgreSQL.
  • Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming, Agile development principles, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Interest in applied AI and automation-driven development.


Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support


If you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

We only accept CVs that are in English.

title: Oracle EBS Developer
description:
Job Title: Technical Consultant – Oracle EBS R12 (FRICEW)

Job Type- Contract

Location- Remote 100%

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced Technical Consultant with strong hands-on experience in Oracle E-Business Suite R12. The candidate should have solid experience working on FRICEW components (Forms, Reports, Integrations, Conversions, Enhancements, Workflow) and strong PL/SQL skills.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and customize Oracle EBS R12 objects.
  • Work on FRICEW components:
  • Forms customization
  • Reports (XML/BI Publisher, Oracle Reports)
  • Integrations (inbound & outbound interfaces)
  • Data conversions
  • Enhancements
  • Workflow development
  • Develop and support PL/SQL packages, procedures, and triggers.
  • Create and maintain technical design documents (TDD).
  • Work closely with functional consultants and business users.
  • Support testing, deployment, and production issues.


Required Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in Oracle EBS R12.
  • Strong experience in FRICEW development.
  • Excellent PL/SQL and SQL knowledge.
  • Experience with XML Publisher / BI Publisher.
  • Knowledge of APIs, Interface Tables, and Concurrent Programs.
  • Experience in Workflow customization.
  • Basic Unix shell scripting knowledge.


Preferred Skills

  • Implementation or upgrade project experience.
  • Knowledge of Finance or SCM modules.
  • Good communication and documentation skills.

title: DevOps Engineer with AWS - Relocation from Brasil to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • Technical or Bachelor’s Degree in IT-related areas (at least level 5 or 6);
  • Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in IT areas (Infrastructure, Software Development, Systems Administration);
  • At least 3 years of professional experience working as a DevOps Engineer (mandatory);
  • Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience working with AWS cloud environment (e.g. EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, CloudWatch, EKS/ECS, and Lambda);
  • Experience with IaC tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar;
  • Experience with CI/CD and Automation such as Jenkins, Ansible, Chef, and Puppet (valued);
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes;
  • Professional experience with programming and scripting languages (e.g., Python, Java, Bash, Shell, or similar);
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools;
  • English proficiency (at least B2 in conversation – mandatory);
  • Availability for relocation from Brasil to Portugal (mandatory).


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid (2-3 times in the office) or remote, based in Lisbon or Porto cities .


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and apply for this opportunity.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - . The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority –

(please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to criminal convictions and offences.)
