title: Consultor de Pré Vendas - SDR
description:
Nós somos a EasyJur e estamos mudando o mundo!

A EasyJur é uma Legaltech que tem como missão revolucionar a forma de trabalho do advogado por meio da inteligência humana e artificial. Sabemos que construímos algo que é genuinamente útil para as pessoas: todo advogado ou advogada que adota o #easyjur como sua solução central tem percebido rapidamente os benefícios gerados pela transformação digital.

Acreditamos que pensar e fazer diferente é o caminho para superar as injustiças que vivemos e transformar as dificuldades em combustível para criar não somente um software jurídico e sim construir um mundo mais justo.


Seja um #Easyforce com a gente!

O que a gente espera de você?

Buscamos uma pessoa talentosa que queira fazer parte de um time de alta performance A pessoa ideal precisa estar alinhada a nossa cultura, apresentando sede de vencer, tenha habilidade de resolver problemas, proativa, autogerenciável, analítica, focada, resiliente, que goste de pensar fora da caixa e de trabalhar em equipe.


Essa pessoa será responsável por proporcionar mudanças ao operador do Direito com o sistema Easyjur, com objetivo de mapear os desafios e necessidades para oferecer soluções criativas para nossos clientes, tornando a vida das pessoas mais simples, agradável e produtiva. 


No seu dia a dia, você vai:

  • Fazer o primeiro contato com novos leads:
  • Mapear as oportunidades para o time de vendas;
  • Interagir com prospects via telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail, etc.;
  • Agendar reunião entre o potencial cliente e nossos executivos de vendas;
  • Gerar interesse e desenvolver esses leads para fornecer mais oportunidades para o time de vendas;
  • Entender e solucionar as principais objeções de potenciais clientes.
  • Desenvolver relacionamento com o cliente e apoiá-lo em sua jornada


O que buscamos de conhecimento técnico?

  • Experiência na área como SDR e vendas B2B
  • Conhecimento em funil de vendas e processo de vendas consultivas
  • Conhecimento e domínio de SPIN Selling
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de inside sales e inbound/outbound
  • Escrita de script de conexão com leads \"abertura de portas\"
  • Avançada comunicação verbal e escrita
  • Curso completo ou em andamento de Direito, Administração, Ciências Contábeis, engenharia ou áreas correlatas

O que gostaríamos, porém não é obrigatório:

  • Experiência com SaaS na área jurídica
  • Habilidade e conhecimento do HubSpot
  • Conhecimento sobre OKRs
  • Entendimento do mercado jurídico, suas demandas, desafios e como a tecnologia pode otimizar processos e melhorar resultados em escritórios de advocacia e departamentos jurídicos.

O que você pode esperar de nós:

  • Aqui você vai encontrar um time comprometido em trabalhar em alta performance e a entregar resultados acima da média;
  • Um ambiente dinâmico além do padrão de empresas tradicionais e hierarquias verticais;
  • Aqui quebramos o paradigma de ?manda quem pode e obedece quem tem juízo\";
  • Temos como meta diária empoderar as pessoas e potencializar talentos.


Benefícios:


  • Programa EasyFamily
  • Programa Saúde e bem estar - Plano de saúde, atividade física e apoio psicológico;
  • Apoio internet backup (Remotos)
  • Day off em seu aniversário;
  • Frutas frescas e café da manhã todos os dias (Presenciais);
  • Bônus por indicação de novos colaboradores e/ou prestadores de serviços.
  • Bolsa de 50% para curso de inglês;
  • Bolsa para especializações e estudos;
  • Plano de desenvolvimento e crescimento;
  • Possibilidade de contrato stock options;

title: StarRocks Database Engineer (DBE) - Remote
description:
Database Engineer (DBE) – Enterprise Open-Source Support

Location : Remote (preferred South / Central America or US TIme Zones)

Department : Engineering - Open Source Database support

Reports to: CTO / VP Engineering


About Deep.BI

We provide enterprise support and consulting for open‑source analytics and data infrastructure platforms such as Apache Druid, Apache Flink, StarRocks and other emerging technologies.Our customers run mission‑critical, high‑volume systems and rely on us to keep them fast, stable, and available. We’re a small, world-class expert, remote‑first team working across multiple time zones (US, Brazil, Europe, India, Philippines), supporting 100+ customer environments with SLAs ranging from advisory support to 24/7 incident coverage.


Role Overview

As a Database Engineer (DBE), you will be the core L3/L4 technical expert responsible for solving the most complex database problems our customers face in production with an emphasis on supporting StarRocks clusters. You’ll dive deep into query optimization, ingestion pipelines, schema design, and HA/DR configuration — ensuring that large-scale analytical systems remain reliable, scalable, and performant.


While your primary focus is database internals and advanced troubleshooting, we value engineers with broader skills — knowledge of DevOps, Infrastructure, security or SRE Practices is highly appreciated and will make you even more impactful. 


Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced troubleshooting (L3/L4): Diagnose and resolve complex issues in StarRocks and other OLAP database clusters (performance Bottlenecks, ingestion failures, query regressions)
  • Performance optimization: Tune queries, schemas, ingestion flows, and configs to maximize efficiency under high load.
  • Architecture & design support: Work with Solution Architects to shape data models, indexing strategies, and HA/DR approaches.
  • Incident resolution under 24/7 SLA: Comfortable debugging under SLA pressure and participating in on-call rotations. Act as the escalation point for production incidents, ensuring rapid root cause analysis and fixes.
  • CVE patching: Apply, validate, and test security patches for database systems in customer environments.
  • Knowledge sharing: Document best practices, contribute to playbooks, and mentor junior engineers when needed.
  • Optional / nice-to-have:
  • Support deployments with DevOps engineers (Kubernetes, cloud, automation)
  • Assist in secure configuration and compliance requirements
  • Collaborate with developers (DD role) on upstream OSS bug fixes or feature contributions.


Requirements

  • 2+ years hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting StarRocks clusters in larger scale production (not just querying or dashboard usage; no PoCs) 
  • Proven experience with query optimization,indexing, schema design, and ingestion pipelines .
  • Solid knowledge of distributed systems concepts (consistency, replication, failover, scaling)
  • Hands-on experience with high availability and disaster recovery setups
  • Comfort with Linux systems, networking basics and SQL .
  • Ability to analyze logs, metrics, and configs under pressure (incident scenarios)
  • Strong English language communication skills — able to explain technical decisions clearly to engineers and delivery managers both verbally and in writing
  • Bonus: Experience with Apache Druid, ClickHouse, TiDB, Apache Cassandra, or similar databases
  • Bonus : Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infra (AWS/GCP/Azure), or security best practices (RBAC, encryption, IAM).
  • Bonus : Contributions to open-source database projects.


What we offer

  • Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies at enterprise scale .
  • Opportunity to collaborate with top engineers across databases, communities.
  • Competitive salary 
  • Support for conference travel and OSS contributions
  • Flexible contract structure (direct employment or via a global payroll partner or contractor/B2B), depending on your location and preference.


Location & working style

  • Remote‑first - we collaborate online across multiple time zones.
  • Role requires regular overlap with European and North American business hours.

title: Implementation Manager
description:
About the job


Sphere Pay is looking for a full-time Implementation Manager based in Miami or Brazil. As an Implementation Manager at Sphere Pay, you will be the critical bridge between our sales/GTM team and our product organization, ensuring customers can successfully integrate and leverage our API-first payment infrastructure. The work you do directly supports our customers' ability to move money with us; you will regularly have an outsized impact on Sphere Pay's customer success and product evolution.

Key Responsibilities:


Technical Discovery & Solution Design: Partner with the Head of BD on discovery calls to gather customer technical requirements. Assess requirements against our current capabilities, architect tailored solutions, and clearly communicate any gaps to our product team. You will translate complex customer needs into actionable product feedback.


Integration Lifecycle Management: Own the full integration lifecycle from initial discovery call through final go-live. This includes creating development guides, providing hands-on support during implementation, and ensuring customers have a clear path to successful integration with our API.


Customer Technical Support: Handle integration requests from the sales team post-discovery. Guide external developers on how to integrate our API, explaining not just the how but the why behind integration decisions.


Product Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the customer to our product team. Translate specific customer requests into product requirements and advocate for features that will improve the customer experience and expand our capabilities.


Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Build long-term partnerships with clients acting as the primary point of contact for technical inquiries and strategic planning. Track, report, and update necessary internal systems related to client implementations.


Qualifications:


  • Fluency in English, Portuguese Required - Spanish business level fluency is nice to have
  • 3+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, or API Implementation
  • Strong technical background with hands-on experience working with APIs and guiding developers through integrations.
  • Proven experience writing technical documentation, API docs, and integration guides.
  • Experience within payments and/or fintech required.
  • Crypto/Web3 is a plus but not required.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Self-starter comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
  • Fully Remote - Based in Miami or Brazil (preferred).


Sphere Pay is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and experiences to apply.

Sphere Pay is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workforce. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

title: Desenvolvedor Angular Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Desenvolvimento e Arquitetura: Liderar o desenvolvimento de novas soluções frontend, definindo a arquitetura mais adequada e garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas de mercado.

Criação de Componentes: Desenvolver componentes de UI reutilizáveis, performáticos e acessíveis, que servirão de base para nossas aplicações.

Colaboração Estratégica: Trabalhar em colaboração direta com designers de UI/UX para garantir a fidelidade e a viabilidade técnica das interfaces, e com engenheiros de backend para definir e consumir APIs.

Qualidade de Código: Promover uma cultura de alta qualidade, escrevendo código bem documentado, implementando testes automatizados e participando ativamente de code reviews.

Performance e Otimização: Monitorar e otimizar continuamente a performance das aplicações para garantir uma experiência de usuário rápida e fluida.


Requisitos Essenciais

Domínio em Frameworks JavaScript: Experiência sênior e profundo conhecimento em Angular. Você deve ser uma referência técnica em pelo menos um desses ecossistemas.

Fundamentos Sólidos: Maestria em HTML5, CSS3, e JavaScript (ES6+), com proficiência em TypeScript.

Ecossistema Moderno: Experiência sólida com ferramentas de build (Webpack/Vite), gerenciadores de pacotes (NPM/Yarn), e controle de versão com Git.

Integração de APIs: Vasta experiência no consumo de APIs RESTful ou GraphQL.

Testes Automatizados: Experiência prática na implementação de estratégias de testes unitários, de integração e e2e (ex: Jest, Cypress, Jasmine/Karma).

Gerenciamento de Estado: Conhecimento sólido em bibliotecas de gerenciamento de estado relevantes para seu framework de domínio (ex: Redux, Zustand, Context API para React; Services, NgRx para Angular).


Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Desenvolvimento e Arquitetura: Liderar o desenvolvimento de novas soluções frontend, definindo a arquitetura mais adequada e garantindo a aplicação das melhores práticas de mercado.

Criação de Componentes: Desenvolver componentes de UI reutilizáveis, performáticos e acessíveis, que servirão de base para nossas aplicações.

Colaboração Estratégica: Trabalhar em colaboração direta com designers de UI/UX para garantir a fidelidade e a viabilidade técnica das interfaces, e com engenheiros de backend para definir e consumir APIs.

Qualidade de Código: Promover uma cultura de alta qualidade, escrevendo código bem documentado, implementando testes automatizados e participando ativamente de code reviews.

Domínio em Frameworks JavaScript: Experiência sênior e profundo conhecimento em Angular. Você deve ser uma referência técnica em pelo menos um desses ecossistemas.

Ecossistema Moderno: Experiência sólida com ferramentas de build (Webpack/Vite), gerenciadores de pacotes (NPM/Yarn), e controle de versão com Git.

Integração de APIs: Vasta experiência no consumo de APIs RESTful ou GraphQL.

Testes Automatizados: Experiência prática na implementação de estratégias de testes unitários, de integração e e2e (ex: Jest, Cypress, Jasmine/Karma).

Gerenciamento de Estado: Conhecimento sólido em bibliotecas de gerenciamento de estado relevantes para seu framework de domínio (ex: Redux, Zustand, Context API para React; Services, NgRx para Angular).

title: Content Operations Specialist
description:
Must Apply Online. Use Form below.


Company Description


Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, LinkedIn, social media, and podcast channels .


Role Description


The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.


This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.


The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.


What You Will Do


Content & Provider Curation

  • Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
  • Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
  • Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
  • Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Plan and coordinate content across:
  • Email marketing
  • Blog
  • LinkedIn
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions
  • Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
  • Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces

Podcast & Media Coordination

  • Manage podcast promotion workflows, including:
  • Episode launch coordination
  • Provider or guest features
  • Cross-posting to email, blog, and social channels
  • Ensure podcast content is repurposed and distributed consistently

Coordination & Execution Flow

  • Create clear content briefs, lineups, and timelines for:
  • Email upload and formatting support
  • Social scheduling support
  • Podcast and blog publishing
  • Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication
  • Review scheduled content for accuracy, completeness, and coverage

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor inbound interest generated from content
  • Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
  • Track engagement and performance across channels
  • Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings


Who You Are

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable managing content across multiple channels at scale
  • Strong written English (professional working proficiency)
  • Process-driven and systems-oriented
  • Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows
  • Clear communicator who keeps work moving across teams


Qualifications

  • Content development and management skills, including the ability to write, edit, and optimize engaging and impactful content
  • Proficiency in content strategy and workflow management, as well as experience with content management systems (CMS)
  • Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret data and apply insights to enhance content performance
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product teams
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with an ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of SEO, digital marketing principles, and content optimization best practices
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field
  • Experience in the health or wellness industry is highly desirable

title: Business Process Analyst I
description:
Descrição da função:

1. Design e Documentação de Processos GTM

  • Documentar e aprimorar os principais processos de execução de GTM (Go-To-Market), incluindo:
  • Transferência de leads e demanda
  • Fluxo de oportunidades e negociações
  • Adoção, renovações e estratégias de expansão
  • Definir claramente responsabilidades, transições entre equipes e expectativas em cada etapa
  • Identificar lacunas de execução, pontos de atrito e inconsistências
  • Produzir mapas de processo, documentação clara e playbooks leves


2. Métricas de GTM e Visibilidade de Execução

  • Definir e padronizar um conjunto principal de métricas de execução de GTM (ex: conversão, saúde do pipeline, velocidade de negociações, renovações)
  • Alinhar definições e uso das métricas entre as equipes
  • Criar visualizações simples ou dashboards para identificar problemas e riscos na execução
  • Usar insights para recomendar melhorias específicas nos processos


3. Colaboração Multifuncional

  • Facilitar reuniões de trabalho com times de Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e Operações
  • Registrar decisões e transformá-las em documentação clara
  • Apoiar iniciativas das equipes com análises estruturadas e acompanhamento contínuo

title: Especialista de Operações (Operations Specialist)
description:

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.



Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.



TL;DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.



This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:


\"We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.



What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.



Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.



Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.



Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.



Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.



What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.



Technical Expectations

Cloud

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) - important
  • AWS
  • Azure
  • GCP

    • DevOps

    • Docker
    • Kubernetes
    • Terraform or other Infrastructure-as-Code tools
    • CI/CD pipelines
    • Linux systems administration
    • Networking fundamentals

    Automation

    Comfortable writing scripts in Bash, Python, Go, or similar.


    Languages

    Portuguese required. English is a plus as some clients are international, so it may eventually become useful in the future, but it's not required.


    Why work with Quave

    We are a small, profitable, independent company. No investors. No corporate bureaucracy. We focus on doing great work for clients and building great software.

    Things we value: Speed. Quality. Pragmatism. Autonomy.

    Quave literally stands for Quality (Qua) and Velocity (Ve).


    Pay and Benefits

    This is a full-time remote position. Compensation will depend on experience.

    • Fully remote work
    • Flexible hours
    • 22 days paid time off per year
    • Quarterly bonus based on company performance
    • AI allowance for productivity tools

    We work as a distributed team of independent contractors.


    Hiring Process

    • Application review
    • Technical conversation
    • Architecture discussion
    • Conversation(s) with one or more partners
    • This is a leadership role and you will coordinate other engineers as the DevOps work grows. But at Quave our leaders are hands-on. You should be comfortable writing automation and infrastructure code yourself when needed.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps / Cloud Lead who knows how to design, automate, and operate cloud infrastructure.

This role focuses heavily on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) due to a strategic partnership in that ecosystem. Many of our clients are migrating infrastructure to OCI or need help operating multi-cloud environments.

We need someone who can design solutions, automate processes, and solve infrastructure problems, not just maintain pipelines.



Why this role exists

We have a strategic partnership with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). Clients are asking us to migrate infrastructure to OCI, and many of them also need ongoing DevOps operations and architecture support.

We need someone who can own this technically. Not just executing tasks, but executing the task is an important part of the job as well.

Design solutions. Talk to clients. Automate migrations. Coordinate engineers. And when necessary, jump in and fix things yourself.



TL;DR

You will help lead cloud and DevOps initiatives at Quave. Your job is to:

  • Lead cloud migrations to OCI
  • Design cloud architectures
  • Automate migrations and infrastructure
  • Coordinate DevOps engineers
  • Talk directly to clients
  • Help build repeatable DevOps processes

You must be strong in OCI, comfortable with AWS / Azure / GCP, hands-on, obsessed with automation, and comfortable discussing technical architecture with clients.

English is a plus, not required.



This is not a ticket-based DevOps job

If you're looking for a role where you maintain Jenkins pipelines, restart servers, open support tickets, and wait for instructions, this is not the role for you.

This role is about designing and solving infrastructure problems. We want someone who can look at a system and think:


\"We can automate 80% of this.\"

And then actually build the automation.



What you'll actually do

Cloud Architecture Design infrastructure for systems running in OCI, AWS, Azure, and GCP, migrating from one to another.



Cloud Migrations

A lot of our work will be migrations like AWS → OCI, Azure → OCI, GCP → OCI.

Your job is not just to do the migration, but to help us turn migrations into repeatable processes, scripts, templates, automation and tooling so that each migration becomes easier than the last.



Automation

We want to automate everything that can be automated:

  • Automated infrastructure provisioning
  • Migration scripts
  • CI/CD pipelines
  • Environment replication
  • Monitoring setups

If you like writing scripts that replace hours of manual work, you'll enjoy this role.



Client Discussions

You will often join calls with clients to understand infrastructure problems, design migration strategies, estimate effort, and propose solutions. You must be comfortable discussing technical topics clearly.



Leading DevOps Engineers

As the DevOps work grows, you'll coordinate other engineers working on projects, reviewing architecture, guiding implementations, and ensuring quality.



What we're looking for

You probably have many years working with infrastructure. But more importantly, you have good instincts about systems.

You likely:

  • Love automating infrastructure
  • Hate manual processes
  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems
  • Are comfortable debugging production environments
  • Enjoy designing architectures
  • Can communicate clearly with both engineers and clients

You should also be comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Cursor can dramatically increase productivity when used well. We expect you to take advantage of that.

  • Hibrído SP;
  • Oportunidade PJ;
  • Circuito de treinamentos
  • Programa de Educação Continuada
  • Desafios e oportunidades de crescimento

  • Inglês avançado
  • Projetar e otimizar APIs RESTful usando Spring Boot
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e desempenho de sistemas distribuídos

Orquestração de APIs via iComposer (Groovy – low-code).

IHub / Gestão de Integrações (OPA – low-code).

Java 11 e 17

Spring Framework (Spring Batch, Spring Cloud) JPA Javascript (es6+) Micro-services e Open API (antigo swagger) JUnit( JUnit 5 ),Mockito( Mockito framework site )

SpringTest (Testing :: Spring Framework)

React (component lifecycle, setState, setState callback, props as functions, hooks)

Groovy ( The Apache Groovy programming language ) Docker e Kubernetes Typescript Jest (JavaScript Testing Framework) Flexbox (Flexbox - Aprendendo desenvolvimento web | MDN , Flexbox Froggy ) Modelagem de banco de dados OPA ( Open Policy Agent | Documentation ) Conhecimento de seguros;

title: Front-End & UI/UX Designer
description:
Hey, Dingus!


Yep—you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we’re on the hunt for a versatile, design-driven Webflow + WordPress expert who can take a website from concept to completion.


About Us


Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an “unlimited get-shit-done” subscription for our clients—from websites to social to SEO and everything in between.


Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading.


What You’ll Do


  • Design visually engaging websites using UI/UX best practices, accessibility standards, and performance guidelines in Figma.
  • Develop approved designs into fully-built, functional websites using Webflow and WordPress.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and full website designs that align with user needs and client goals.
  • Use AI tools (Gemini, Claude) for web design, development, and prototyping.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to clarify requirements and ensure flawless execution.
  • Customize, refine, and optimize websites based on client feedback.
  • Stay up-to-date with digital design trends, tools, and new Figma/Webflow/WordPress capabilities.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
⚠️ Important Application Notice

Please select only the role that best aligns with your experience. We will only review your first application. If you apply to multiple positions on LinkedIn, additional submissions will not be processed and may cause your application to be overlooked.


Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?


Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the Week!


Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $800 - $1,280 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,600 - $2,560 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory


Next Steps:


  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

title: Banco de Talentos GFT - QA Automação
description:
Banco de Talentos | QA Automação


Estamos construindo um banco de talentos com foco em profissionais de QA com foco em Automação de Testes, em diferentes níveis de senioridade (Júnior, Pleno, Sênior e Especialista/Tech Lead), que desejam atuar em projetos desafiadores, com foco em qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua dos processos de testes.


Se você busca atuar em ambientes modernos de engenharia, com forte cultura de qualidade e automação, queremos te conhecer!


O que você poderá fazer por aqui

  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir automações de testes (funcionais, integração, regressão, etc.);
  • Definir e implementar estratégias de testes automatizados;
  • Atuar na garantia de qualidade em aplicações web, APIs e, em alguns casos, mobile;
  • Integrar testes automatizados em pipelines de CI/CD;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de desenvolvimento para garantir entregas de alta qualidade;
  • Identificar riscos, gaps de cobertura e oportunidades de melhoria;
  • Contribuir com a evolução das práticas de qualidade e engenharia de testes;
  • Participar de code reviews e disseminar boas práticas de testes.


O que buscamos

  • Experiência com automação de testes (web, APIs e/ou mobile);
  • Conhecimento em linguagens como Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python ou similares;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com testes de APIs (Postman, RestAssured ou similares);
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git);
  • Vivência com integração contínua e pipelines de CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.);
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de testes (pirâmide de testes, testes unitários, integração, E2E);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis;
  • Experiência com automação de testes mobile (ex: Appium) será considerada um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento em testes de performance e/ou segurança é um diferencial;
  • Certificações em qualidade de software (como ISTQB) serão consideradas um diferencial.


Perfil que valorizamos

  • Olhar crítico e atenção a detalhes;
  • Pensamento analítico e foco em qualidade;
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade sobre as entregas;
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com times multidisciplinares;
  • Curiosidade e interesse por novas ferramentas e práticas de testes;
  • Autonomia e organização na gestão do próprio trabalho.


Se identificou? Cadastre-se no nosso banco de talentos e fique por dentro das oportunidades que podem surgir

title: Pessoa Cientista de Dados - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas negras
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact!

Quais serão suas responsabilidades:

Você se juntará à nossa equipe de Dados e Consultoria, que ajuda os clientes a transformar e melhorar sua estratégia de dados aplicando análises avançadas para gerar insights que criam valor de negócio a partir de big data e inteligência artificial.

  • Inovar . Você trabalhará com sua equipe, composta por consultores, cientistas de dados, e engenheiros, para identificar as necessidades dos clientes e definir soluções inovadoras.
  • Aprender e Compartilhar. Você trabalhará em uma equipe colaborativa que promove o compartilhamento de conhecimento. Você aprenderá com outras pessoas, compartilhará conhecimento e ficará a par das novidades/atualizações do setor.
  • Desenvolver. Você participará da solução do início ao fim. Com o auxílio de cientistas seniores você gerenciará a concepção e a implementação, além de otimizar o desempenho e a escalabilidade.
  • Atuar em toda a cadeia de valor dos projetos (coleta e tratamento de dados, análise exploratória de dados, aplicação de modelos de aprendizado de máquina, produtização de modelos)
  • Popularizar termos técnicos ou soluções para perfis mais orientados a negócios, pode trabalhar em uma equipe com perfis muito diversificados
  • Priorizar suas tarefas, respeitar prazos e se levantar a mão em caso de riscos ou problemas

O que nós estamos procurando:

Ter cursado um curso de graduação em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina, matemática, ciência da computação, estatística, engenharia, economia ou uma área relacionada.

  • Desejável um primeiro conhecimento em estatística e programação (Python/R).
  • Curiosidade: você está sempre buscando soluções inovadoras para seus clientes, você está envolvido em toda a cadeia de valor
  • Colaboração : o compartilhamento de conhecimento é essencial para você e você participa ativamente da difusão de informações dentro da Artefact
  • Empreendedorismo : você traz soluções, novas ideias, inovações

O que oferecemos:

  • VR/VT
  • Free office (trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!)
  • Gympass
  • Seguros: Vida, saúde e odontológico
  • Encontros Bimestrais (Famoso “Get Together” onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!
  • Woba (pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!)
  • Avaliações semestrais (com oportunidade de promoção)

Por que você deveria se juntar a nós:

  • Artefact é o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da área de dados.
  • Progresso: cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender.
  • Cultura: Empatia e Colaboração está no nosso DNA.
  • Empreendedorismo: você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria!

Junte-se a nós!

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Coordenação do Departamento de Marketing compreendendo Trade, Comunicação, CRM e Programa de Benefícios;
  • Planejamento do calendário anual de campanhas e eventos e elaboração de plano de marketing com o orçamento de despesas de sua área;
  • Controle financeiro;
  • Negociação com parceiros e patrocínios;
  • Interface com agência de publicidade e promoção: elaboração de briefings de campanhas, plano de mídia, comunicação interna do shopping, campanhas promocionais (mecânica, documentação, premiação, prestação de contas);
  • Responsável pela comunicação do shopping com a assessoria de imprensa: aprovação de releases e sugestão de pautas;
  • Preservar a imagem do empreendimento junto ao público em geral e lojistas;
  • Contribuir com a Gerência de Marketing, participando de reuniões sistemáticas com a equipe para avaliação de metas setoriais, acompanhamento dos indicadores de qualidade, desenvolvimento de planos de melhoria contínua e intercâmbio de informações.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Comunicação, Publicidade e áreas correlatas;
  • Diferenciais: MBA em administração, comunicação, marketing, produção de eventos.
  • Pacote Office Avançado;


Informações adicionais:


O Que Temos Para Você

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Coordenação do Departamento de Marketing compreendendo Trade, Comunicação, CRM e Programa de Benefícios;
  • Planejamento do calendário anual de campanhas e eventos e elaboração de plano de marketing com o orçamento de despesas de sua área;
  • Controle financeiro;
  • Negociação com parceiros e patrocínios;
  • Interface com agência de publicidade e promoção: elaboração de briefings de campanhas, plano de mídia, comunicação interna do shopping, campanhas promocionais (mecânica, documentação, premiação, prestação de contas);
  • Responsável pela comunicação do shopping com a assessoria de imprensa: aprovação de releases e sugestão de pautas;
  • Preservar a imagem do empreendimento junto ao público em geral e lojistas;
  • Contribuir com a Gerência de Marketing, participando de reuniões sistemáticas com a equipe para avaliação de metas setoriais, acompanhamento dos indicadores de qualidade, desenvolvimento de planos de melhoria contínua e intercâmbio de informações.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Comunicação, Publicidade e áreas correlatas;
  • Diferenciais: MBA em administração, comunicação, marketing, produção de eventos.
  • Pacote Office Avançado;

title: JD Edwards Developer -  (Relocation to Portugal)
description:
Note: This role requires relocation to Portugal — We will provide full support with the legal aspects of the relocation process.


Jobbex , a company that empowers people & organizations by matching great talents to great projects is looking for the next JD Edwards Developer to support one of our clients.


If you feel inspired to make a change and if you want to be part of the cool kid on the block, this opportunity is for you!

Be ready to find at Jobbex Portugal the transparent, friendly, and professional work environment you have been looking for.


You'll be a great match if you have:

  • Translate business and functional requirements into technical solutions

  • Collaborate with functional consultants and stakeholders to support finance and sales-related processes
  • Troubleshoot issues and ensure system performance, stability, and reliability

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Experience supporting finance or order-to-cash processes is a plus
  • Experience in enterprise or manufacturing environments is an advantage
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

Apply and lets talk!

title: Customer Support Specialist (POS)
description:
Provide technical support for HungerRush Point of Sale to ensure the stable operation of

customer hardware and software products. This includes troubleshooting, configuring,

maintaining, supporting, and optimizing all HungerRush Point of Sale products, PC

hardware, software, and communication links. This job requires a technical understanding

of IT, an appreciation of the food industry, and strong customer service skills.

Essential Responsibilities and Duties:


  • Provide first class Technical Support over the phone
  • Identify, analyze, and correct technical and software issues
  • Work customer cases efficiently with the goal of optimizing and improving customer

satisfaction

  • Ensure customers issues are dealt with in a timely fashion
  • Ensure that customer satisfaction is maintained
  • Maintain an available status to provide quick response times for customers calls
  • Work closely with other departments to provide prompt resolutions to customer

issues


Education :

  • Minimum – High school diploma (or Equivalent)
  • Preferred – Associates Degree (or higher)


Experience:

  • Must Have: 1-3 years of experience in computer technology (prior help desk or call center experiences supporting a software product a big plus)
  • Preferred but not required:
  • Technical certifications (examples: Net+, CompTIA A+ or an AAS degree or equivalent)
  • Previous experience working in the hospitality industry
  • Familiarity with POS equipment
  • Bilingual Speaker (preferable) (Spanish/English)


What You Need For This Position:

  • Be flexible with working schedules, including nights and weekends
  • Possess strong verbal and written communication skills in the English language
  • Communicate effectively in the English language
  • Have strong interpersonal skills, problem solving skills and negotiating skills
  • Think analytically
  • Work in a fast-paced environment
  • Be organized and have strong time management skills
  • Be able to technically troubleshoot and reverse engineer:

1. Windows

2. Networking

3. SQL Server (preferred)

title: Estagiário jurídico
description:
Descrição da Empresa Santos e Silva Advocacia e Consultoria Jurídica é um escritório de advocacia localizado em Curitiba/PR. Com compromisso e excelência, oferecemos serviços jurídicos e consultoria de alta qualidade para atender às necessidades de nossos clientes.

Somos reconhecidos pelo profissionalismo e pelo foco em soluções jurídicas personalizadas. A empresa é movida por valores como ética, transparência e dedicação.

Descrição do Cargo Procuramos um Estagiário Jurídico para integrar nosso time e contribuir com as atividades diárias.

Somos um escritório focado em Direito Trabalhista

As principais responsabilidades incluem a redação de documentos jurídicos, acompanhamento de processos, pesquisa de jurisprudência e apoio na consultoria legal aos clientes.

Esta é uma oportunidade de estágio remota, oferecendo flexibilidade para desempenhar as atividades à distância com comprometimento e autonomia.

Qualificações

  • Direito e Consultoria Jurídica: Conhecimento básico ou em desenvolvimento sobre leis, regulamentações e práticas jurídicas, além de interesse em prestar assessoria legal.
  • Documentação Jurídica: Habilidade na elaboração de documentos jurídicos e na análise de processos com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Comunicação e Análise de Questões Legais: Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, além de capacidade de compreensão e interpretação de questões legais para oferecer soluções eficazes.
  • Será um diferencial estar cursando os últimos períodos de graduação em Direito e ter conhecimento em sistemas jurídicos digitais ou idiomas estrangeiros.

A principal função será atendimento ao público geral, atendimento via whatsapp de consultoria jurídica.

Pagaremos uma bolsa mais bonificações por desempenho podendo chegar ate 2500 de salário mensal

title: Market Intelligence Manager - Americas
description:
Summary of Job Duties


Ensure their regional team fulfils the roles and responsibilities of:

Customer development

  • Lead opportunity assessment: proactively engage in customer development, leverage marketing intelligence capability to assess customer opportunity, generate customer leads from current or potential opportunities driving from new developed product and formulation.
  • Customer development action plan: proactively engage in action plan formulation, and engage in customer communication and execution
  • Customer solution proposal: coordinate external resources to design customized market service plan based on customer’s need

Customer relationship management

  • Proactively engage in relationship mgmt. with KA’s marketing related departments, gathering market insights to support R&D and BD

Marketing service:

  • Delivery & after-sales: responsible for leveraging internal capability and external resources to deliver marketing service and after-sales


Main Responsibilities


Although the position is a management role the candidate also expected to be hands on and involved wherever required for the regional team to carry out the following responsibilities:


  • Market Research

To visit customer site with sales and also collect market information in their region such as:

  • Customer Survey Analysis
  • Customer service needs/opportunities
  • Customer’s org chart
  • Customer’s end consumer insights and trends
  • Prospects and opportunity analysis
  • Category Analysis
  • Sales Channels
  • Competitive landscape


  • Marketing Support Service

Help promote, drive and expand our added value service to our customers to provide them with our 360 marketing solution

  • Market Research/Business Intelligence
  • Receipe support
  • `zSales distribution


  • Account Based Marketing

Will be responsible to perform research to find high-value accounts to target as well as spend time developing growth strategies from their findings. They will ensure marketing activities line up with strategies developed and ultimately translate plans to the sales team for execution. They need to ensure the follow steps are covered:

  • Identify high-value target accounts – Identify key accounts that have the potential to contribute the most to the revenue of your company.
  • Conduct research on those accounts - Get a good snapshot of customer needs and pain points, as well as where they are in their customer journey.
  • Develop customized marketing campaigns - Using information you learned in the research phase to inform your strategy, develop creative assets that will resonate with the target account.
  • Run customized marketing campaigns - Launch your campaigns to the target account.
  • Measure customized marketing campaigns - Analyze the data to see how your campaigns are performing.


  • Online Marketing

Will be in charge of creating localized content regularly update the following marketing channels in their assigned region.

  • Webinars
  • SEO – Quarterly updates on the regional assigned webpage
  • Social media – Weekly updates on social media platforms in where they are based – language will depend on where they are based
  • Email marketing – Monthly articles that can be distributed for sales use in their regions.


  • Offline Marketing

Will handle the planning and implementation of offline marketing tasks in the assigned region which could cover

  • Exhibitions
  • Roadshows
  • Print (Quarterly updates)
  • PowerPoint presentations (Company introductions, products or service introductions)


  • Public Relations
  • Build up media relations and ‘Distribution Media List’ for future press release distribution in their assigned region.
  • Ensure appearance on at least one reputable news website in their assigned region.


Qualifications (Education/Knowledge/Working Experience)


  • Master’s degree in a Marketing related discipline.
  • Around 10 years of experience
  • Knowledgable in hands on B2B2C marketing as well as the consumer market in the beverage industry.


Skills Needed


Market Research and Analysis: The ability to conduct thorough market research, analyze data, and draw actionable insights is crucial for understanding the target market, consumer behavior, and industry trends.

Strategic Planning: Regional Marketing Managers must be adept at developing and executing marketing strategies that align with overall business objectives. This includes setting clear goals, defining KPIs, and creating actionable plans.

Team Leadership and Management: Effective leadership skills are important for managing and motivating a team of marketing professionals. This includes providing guidance, setting expectations, and facilitating collaboration.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Regional Marketing Managers need to work closely with various departments like sales, product development, and supply chain to ensure that marketing initiatives are aligned with overall business operations.

Brand Management: They should have the ability to maintain and enhance the brand image in the specified region. This involves ensuring consistency in messaging, visual identity, and customer experience.

Campaign Management: This skill involves planning, executing, and optimizing marketing campaigns. It requires the ability to set clear objectives, target the right audience, and measure the effectiveness of campaigns.

Budget Management: Effective allocation and management of marketing budgets are essential for maximizing return on investment (ROI) and ensuring that resources are used efficiently.

Data Analysis and Interpretation: Proficiency in using data analytics tools to measure campaign performance, track key metrics, and derive actionable insights is crucial for making informed marketing decisions.

Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills are necessary for conveying marketing messages effectively to various stakeholders, including team members, executives, and external partners.

Adaptability and Flexibility: The ability to adapt to changing market conditions, consumer preferences, and industry trends is vital for staying competitive and achieving long-term success.

Problem-Solving Skills: Regional Marketing Managers should be able to identify challenges and develop creative solutions to overcome them. This includes being resourceful and thinking critically.

Cultural Awareness and Sensitivity: Especially in a regional role, understanding and respecting cultural nuances and preferences is important for tailoring marketing strategies to specific markets.

Time Management: Effectively prioritizing tasks and managing time to meet deadlines is essential in a fast-paced marketing environment.

Tech-Savviness: Familiarity with marketing technology tools and platforms, as well as proficiency in relevant software and applications, is important for executing marketing initiatives efficiently.

Negotiation Skills: The ability to negotiate and build partnerships with external stakeholders, such as agencies, vendors, and media outlets, can be crucial for successful marketing campaigns.

title: ANALISTA PROCESSOS REGULATORIOS JR
description:
Descrição da vaga

Nós somos a Cogna, a maior e mais completa empresa de serviços educacionais do país.

Com quase 60 anos de história e mais de 60 marcas, atuamos de forma ampla e integrada, com soluções para escolas, governos e estudantes dos 2 aos 100 anos.

Entre nossas marcas estão Anglo, Red Balloon e Anhanguera, além das editoras Ática, Saraiva, Scipione, que refletem a diversidade e a força do nosso ecossistema educacional.

Contamos com mais de 26 mil colaboradores e o nosso propósito é claro: oferecer soluções educacionais que impulsionam pessoas e organizações a construírem uma melhor versão de si.

Quer fazer parte de um time que inova e impacta milhões? Sua jornada começa aqui!



Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Processos Regulatórios Jr. para atuar no suporte às rotinas de monitoramento regulatório e organização de informações estratégicas da companhia. A pessoa será responsável por apoiar o controle e atualização de dados, garantindo conformidade e visibilidade dos processos regulatórios para a gestão.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

• Realizar o monitoramento e atualização de controles em Excel, garantindo a organização e confiabilidade das informações.

• Apoiar na gestão e manutenção de aplicações em Power Apps utilizadas pela área.

• Atualizar e alimentar painéis e relatórios de indicadores, assegurando a visibilidade dos processos regulatórios.

• Acompanhar e registrar novas portarias, normas e legislações, mantendo as bases de dados atualizadas.

• Dar suporte técnico e operacional ao time, auxiliando na interpretação de informações regulatórias e organização de documentos.

• Contribuir para a organização de dados e informações sensíveis, garantindo precisão, segurança e rastreabilidade.

• Apoiar na preparação de documentações e materiais para auditorias, diligências ou visitas regulatórias.

• Eventualmente, poderá participar de viagens para suporte em atividades da área.


Requisitos e qualificações

• Organização e atenção a detalhes no tratamento de dados e informações.

• Conhecimento ou familiaridade com Excel (controles e bases de dados).

• Experiência ou interesse em Power Apps e gestão de indicadores/painéis será considerado um diferencial.

• Boa comunicação e capacidade de trabalho colaborativo.


Informações adicionais

O que você pode esperar da gente?

  • Participação nos lucros: resultados com comemoração fazem parte do jeito Cogna.
  • Vale-refeição ou alimentação: num cartão de benefícios flexível.
  • Assistência médica: um abrangente plano de saúde, com inclusão de dependentes e coparticipação.
  • Assistência odontológica: está disponível para manter seu sorriso.


Mas espera, ainda tem mais!

  • Bolsas de estudo de graduação e pós graduação: nossas unidades de ensino para que você e seus dependentes (cônjuge e filhos).
  • Day off no aniversário: você poderá escolher um dia para relaxar e celebrar.
  • Convênio SESC: abre as portas para as inúmeras oportunidades de melhora na qualidade de vida.
  • Convênio farmácia Univers: descontos numa variedade de medicamentos.
  • Universidade corporativa: diversas trilhas e cursos gratuitos na nossa universidade corporativa para você seguir evoluindo com a gente.
  • Descontos em livros: para você adquirir os melhores títulos em nossas editoras.
  • Wellhub (Gympass): para que você possa se movimentar no seu dia a dia.
  • Programa Ninho: Um programa dedicado às nossas famílias que estão aguardando um novo bebê.
  • Valoriza - Programa de Recrutamento Interno: Para impulsionar sua carreira por meio de oportunidades internas.



Aqui, acreditamos no respeito, na diversidade e na busca da inclusão em todas suas frentes. Todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados independentemente de raça, gênero, identidade, expressão de gênero, orientação sexual, nacionalidade, genética, deficiência ou de qualquer outra base.

Nosso propósito é avançar cada vez mais, gerando empregabilidade para talentos diversos. Venha enriquecer nosso time!

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Dados  - Vaga afirmativa para mulheres cis e trans
description:
A vaga atual é para o escritório do Brasil e trabalhamos em um modelo Free Office.

Quem somos:

Nós da Artefact LatAm acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-end Java - Pleno
description:
Descrição da vaga

A FCamara está em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end para atuar em parceria com uma grande varejista.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

• Projetar e construir serviços utilizando a linguagem Java;

• Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para definir, projetar e entregar novos recursos;

• Acompanhar todo o ciclo de vida dos serviços (conceito, projeto, testes, lançamento e suporte);

• Assegurar que aplicativos novos e antigos satisfaçam aos padrões de qualidade;

• Realizar testes unitários de código quanto à robustez, incluindo casos extremos, usabilidade, acessibilidade e confiabilidade geral;

• Descobrir, avaliar e implementar continuamente novas tecnologias para maximizar a eficiência de desenvolvimento.


Requisitos e qualificações


Hard Skill:


• Arquitetura baseada em micro serviços;

• Metodologias Ágeis de Projetos (Scrum / Kanban);

• Java;

• Stack Spring;

• Testes Unitários e de Integração;

• Git e Gitflow;

• Containers baseados Docker;

• Jenkins;

• AWS: API Gateway, Lambda, Fargate, ECS, RDS, SQS, SNS, Secrets Manager, Elasticache (Redis).


Soft Skill:


• Ser comprometido e engajado na proposição e evolução das soluções tanto do ponto de vista técnico, do negócio e da experiência oferecida ao usuário.

• Ter boa capacidade de interação e comunicação com pessoas técnicas e não técnicas.

• Ter alto nível de proatividade.


Seria legal se você tivesse:


• Experiência com desenvolvimento de aplicações móveis;

• Experiência com desenvolvimento baseado em event sourcing;

• Conhecimento em NodeJS/Python/Golang/Groovy;

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.
  • Full training provided—no prior AI experience required.
  • A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics.



*** IMPORTANT NOTICE ***


This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews.


Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further.


We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description:
Veterinary Radiologist - Remote


About SignalPET


SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world.


Role Overview


We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale.


Key Responsibilities


  • Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies.
  • Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports.
  • Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases.
  • Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide.
  • Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects.
  • Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI.


Qualifications


  • Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária .
  • M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging.
  • Strong diagnostic and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English (written and spoken).
  • Self-motivated, reliable, and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable working independently and remotely.


What We Offer


  • Fully remote role (Brazil-based).
  • Supportive, international team and culture.

title: Test Automation Developer
description:
Test Automation Developer

Brazil

Senior QA Automation Engineer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We seek experienced high-performing Software Quality Engineers for positions involving quality assurance and test automation for a Private Cloud Platform solution aimed at enabling distributed Edge computing.

You will join a highly skilled team delivering a highly distributed private cloud platform supporting containerized applications in addition to supporting virtual machines and bare metal nodes.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Analyze requirements, create test plans and test cases, execute functional/exploratory tests;
  • Automate tests through use of test automation tools and through code development;
  • Interact with Software Development team in order to complete ticket cycles;
  • Analyze system and applications and propose test strategy;
  • Participate in technical discussions with customer;
  • Coordinate with development team to drive product quality;
  • Report/Monitor/Verify issues in defect tracking tool (JIRA, Bugzilla, etc);
  • Perform regression tests to validate fixes.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Python for testing;
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containers;
  • Knowledge of creating scripts using automated testing tools;
  • Experience working on Linux platforms.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience developing test cases/plans and ability to analyze code to identify root cause of issues;
  • Experience working with testing tools: Pytest Framework / Cypress;
  • Experience working in an Agile / Scrum / Kanban environment.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Manager, Corporate Development
description:
Manager, Corporate Development at Healthcare Head Office


Perseus Group is a major Operating Group of Constellation Software (csisoftware.com | TSX:CSU), a Canadian-based publicly held company. Perseus Group has over 6,000 employees, across 70+ software business units, operating in 12+ software industry verticals, located in over 40 offices.


The Role

Perseus is growing the Business Development team within our M&A group. This role will be primarily focused on covering the Brazilian software market. The successful candidate must be based in Brazil.

The role is to build strong strategic business relationships that lead to the sourcing of current and future M&A opportunities for Perseus. Relationships will be formed with decision makers (i.e. CEOs/VPs of Corporate Development/founders/owners) of software companies globally, M&A advisors, and private equity/venture capital professionals. Success is defined by building and maintaining meaningful relationships, having clients sign LOI’s and ultimately, the acquisition of software companies/assets by Perseus/Constellation.

Initiating relationships, maintaining relationships, and ultimately being considered and chosen to be acquired by Perseus/Constellation typically takes multiple years. Measurable outcomes, continuous value-add through many M&A conversations/relationships and high-quality market research is what ultimately generates successful acquisitions through time.


Outcomes:

  • Develop and manage an M&A pipeline through Salesforce CRM and create market maps to build strong relationships in assigned software industry vertical(s)
  • Meet and exceed monthly M&A targets, such as meaningful contacts and other measurable M&A sourcing KPIs.
  • Work both autonomously and with M&A leadership to qualify M&A opportunities with efficiency
  • Ensure the lead database is allocated accurately within portfolio verticals
  • Effectively qualify opportunities at the top-end of the acquisition funnel to maintain focus for the Portfolio Managers of the business units.
  • Have a meaningful impact on Perseus Group over a successful tenure in-role


Relevant Experience & Competencies:

  • Experience in a Business Development/Sales position at a software company or client-facing M&A/finance role within business development, sales, and/or account management. Preference for experience in outbound-focused origination roles.
  • A clear interest in developing a long-term pipeline of meaningful relationships with prospects as a career trajectory within software investing.
  • Previous high-performance in Business Development, winning in an autonomous role or, prior success in other walks of life outside professional BD experience, such as entrepreneurship, will be considered.
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence and executive presence to speak with CEOs, M&A advisors, corporate development, private equity and venture capital professionals.
  • Organized, detail oriented, and able to work variable hours.
  • Extraordinary work ethic, proactive with a sense of urgency.
  • Full fluency in Portuguese and at least professional-level fluency in English are required, Spanish fluency is a plus.
  • This role will require occasional in-person travel and can be primarily performed either Remotely within Brazil or from a Hybrid-Sao Paolo, Brazil office.

description:
O Analista de Negócios é responsável pelo desenvolvimento de dashboards Power BI de nível empresarial e análises Salesforce que impulsionam a excelência operacional, o crescimento da receita, a rentabilidade dos serviços e a tomada de decisões executivas. Essa função atua como o motor de dados e insights para as áreas de Serviço de Campo, Suporte Técnico, Atendimento ao Cliente, Treinamento e Gerenciamento de Projetos.

  • Administração e Gestão — Conhecimento dos princípios de negócios e gestão envolvidos no planejamento estratégico, alocação de recursos, modelagem de recursos humanos, técnicas de liderança, métodos de produção e coordenação de pessoas e recursos.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department
