title: Remote AI Quality Analyst (Japanese) - 62136
description:
About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:


As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalization feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months



After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigor. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalized responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Key Qualifications:

  • Japanese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Japanese with a high degree of comp, as Japanese is the focus language for this project.
  • Personal Account Usage: Willingness to use your primary personal Google account (not a testing account) and enable personal data sources for a genuine assessment.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalization quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalization concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalization, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalized AI interactions.

Your day-to-day work will involve:

  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilize your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalization was appropriately applied.
  • Analyzing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilized.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience:

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and minimum 30 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor
  • Engagement Length: 3 months

title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description:
Visual & Brand Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.


You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.


This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface.
  • Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns.
  • Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership.
  • Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity.
  • Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling
  • Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns
  • Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products
  • Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas
  • Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cycles


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces
  • Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo
  • Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms
  • Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelines


If you’re a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

At Company 86, we specialize in cybersecurity, digital transformation, and advanced AI implementation to deliver measurable and secure results for our clients. With decades of real-world experience, we focus on practical and future-ready outcomes through strategy, design, and delivery. Our mission is to ensure successful, transformative solutions that meet the evolving needs of businesses. We are committed to innovation and delivering cutting-edge expertise through our core principles: Cyber, Transformation, and AI.


Role Description

I’m working with a small, high-trust team that’s hiring 2 Staff / Senior Staff Software Engineer  — someone who thrives in ambiguity, takes real ownership, and prefers defining problems rather than waiting for tickets. This is not  a “tasks + Jira board” role. You’d be shaping architecture, shipping meaningful systems, and using agentic coding tools (Cursor / Claude Code, etc.) as true force multipliers — not crutches.

You’d be a great fit if you:

 • Own outcomes end-to-end — not just code

 • Work comfortably across Python + TypeScript / React

 • Have experience integrating LLM APIs  (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.)

 • Enjoy making smart trade-offs with imperfect info

 • Prefer small, high-impact teams over large, process-heavy environments

It’s ideal for someone who notices broken assumptions early, treats ambiguity as raw material, and raises the bar through example rather than process.

title: Senior Database Engineer / Lead DBA (DB2 LUW & Cloud Migration) – Bilingual (EN/PT)
description:
We are hiring for a USA company:


Senior Database Engineer / Lead DBA (DB2 LUW & Cloud Migration) – Bilingual (EN/PT)


About the Role:

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Database Administrator (DBA) to join our Global Mainframe DB2 LUW team. This is not a typical application development role; we are looking for a \"under-the-hood\" expert who understands database internals, performance optimization, and the complexities of migrating data between NoSQL and Relational environments.

As a technical lead, you will manage high-stakes backend operations, automate audit compliance, and guide the team through complex data mapping and environment refreshes.

What You Will Do

  • Core Administration: Perform deep-dive backend management of DB2 LUW (Linux, Unix, Windows) environments.
  • Environment Management: Execute test environment refreshes and manage data flow from Archive (AR) environments into active test streams.
  • Modernization & Migration: Lead the charge in migrating data from NoSQL to Relational databases, focusing on complex data mapping, relationship building, and schema design.
  • Cloud & NoSQL: Manage tasks related to AWS RDS and NoSQL platforms, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Automation & Compliance: Develop automation scripts for audit compliance and security protocols.
  • Performance Tuning: Act as the subject matter expert for advanced SQL tuning and database optimization.
  • Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and leadership to junior and mid-level engineers.

Required Qualifications

  • Language: Native or professional fluency in both English and Portuguese is mandatory.
  • Mainframe DB2 LUW
  • Expertise in DB2 LUW: Extensive experience in backend DB2 LUW administration (not just interfacing via apps).
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record of migrating data between different architectures (Relational vs. NoSQL).
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with Amazon RDS and NoSQL databases.
  • Advanced Tuning: Expert-level ability to diagnose and resolve complex SQL performance issues.
  • Location: Remote friendly—we value your skillset over your physical location.

title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Cloud Infrastructure Engineer

Contract: PJ

Duration: Open-ended

We are seeking a motivated DevOps Engineer to support cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. This role offers the opportunity to work with modern cloud-native technologies while contributing to reliable, scalable systems across multi-cloud platforms.

This is a contract position , open to remote candidates located in North or South America , and will report to a Senior Manager of DevOps Engineering .


What You’ll Do

  • Participate in a regular on-call rotation , responding to incidents reliably and professionally
  • Maintain and evolve AWS cloud infrastructure , leveraging automation and infrastructure-as-code
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning using Terraform
  • Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines , enabling agile and self-service software delivery
  • Manage and support containerized applications running on Kubernetes
  • Collaborate closely with Software Engineers and other DevOps team members to solve complex technical problems
  • Quickly absorb technical context while ramping up in a dynamic environment
  • Contribute to best practices that enhance system reliability, scalability, and performance


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4–6 years of experience in DevOps, SRE, or a related role
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS and/or GCP
  • Experience with relational databases (Postgres, MySQL, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes
  • Experience with GitOps / CI/CD tools (e.g., Harness, Argo, Flux, Jenkins)
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi)
  • Exposure to logging, monitoring, and observability tools such as:
  • Datadog
  • Prometheus
  • Grafana
  • ELK Stack
  • CloudWatch
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineers working primarily in Pacific Time (PST)


Nice to Have

  • Experience developing automation or tooling using languages beyond shell scripting (e.g., Go, Python, Java, Elixir )
  • Experience building or supporting platform tooling for development, staging, or integration environments
  • Strong skills debugging performance or networking issues in Kubernetes-based applications
  • Familiarity with audit and compliance frameworks (SOX, SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS)
  • Working knowledge of UNIX/Linux operating systems
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field

title: Data Software Engineer (US/UK International Projects)
description:
Software Engineer - Data Platform (International Client)

Location: Florianópolis, Brazil | Hybrid

Language: English (daily use with US/UK clients)


About the Opportunity

Join our consultancy team and work directly with a leading insurance company in the US/UK, building their complete data platform from the ground up. This is your chance to bring world-class, AI augmented software engineering practices to a greenfield data engineering project while collaborating daily with international teams.


What You'll Do

  • Design and build a robust data platform for a major insurance company
  • Orchestrate AI agents to research, plan and implement complex data pipelines while demonstrating to the wider team how to leverage these tools to increase velocity and quality.
  • Bring solid software engineering principles to data engineering challenges
  • Work embedded within the client's team, driving technical excellence
  • Collaborate in English with distributed teams across the US and UK


What We're Looking For

Must Have:

  • Excellent communication skills in English - you'll be working daily with international clients
  • Strong software engineering mindset - clean code, testing, reliability, and maintainability are in your DNA
  • Deep understanding of relational databases and large-scale data systems
  • Full AI-Augmented Development - you're already using AI agents and modern dev tools


You'll Thrive Here If:

  • You want international exposure while staying in Brazil
  • You value engineering excellence over quick fixes
  • You're excited about hybrid work (office + remote flexibility in Floripa)
  • You see data engineering as a software engineering discipline


About Us

We're a Florianópolis-based software development and consultancy company working with clients in the US and UK. We believe in combining the best of Brazilian tech talent with international opportunities.


Ready to level up your career with international experience? Let's talk.

title: Node.Js Developer | Senior
description:
Você fará parte da Compass UOL, uma das arcas da empresa global AI/R Comany ! Atuamos na transformação digital de organizações, ajudando-as a inovar e alcançar resultados de impacto.

Desenvolvemos plataformas digitais e soluções que impulsionam negócios, promovendo eficiência, escalabilidade e experiências diferenciadas.

Com foco em atrair e desenvolver os melhores talentos, criamos oportunidades que transformam vidas e reforçam o papel positivo da tecnologia na sociedade


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Procurar sempre criar a melhor experiência de uso para o usuário final, trabalhando de forma colaborativa com desenvolvedores, designers e stakeholders para garantir o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Participar ativamente na resolução de problemas complexos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo soluções inovadoras;
  • Escrever código limpo, testável, de fácil manutenção, utilizando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Participar ativamente do processo de revisão de código, atuando tanto como revisor quanto como autor, garantindo a qualidade e a funcionalidade das features desenvolvidas;
  • Acompanhar o comportamento das aplicações em produção usando as principais métricas de saúde e performance disponíveis nas ferramentas de monitoração, buscando insights de melhorias e entendendo anomalias a partir dessas métricas;
  • Atuar no backend que é a interface de consumo dos dados para todos os front-ends, garantindo resiliência e suporte à alta carga de acessos simultâneos;
  • Contribuir com a aplicação responsável pela entrega do site web do produto, utilizando o ambiente como campo de experimentação e aprendizado sobre o comportamento dos usuários.



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Conhecimentos sólidos em Node.JS
  • Conhecimentos sólidos do sistema de controle de versão Git;
  • Visão sobre design patterns (Criacionais, Estruturais e Comportamentais);
  • Domínio de boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (DRY, KISS, TDA, SoC, SOLID);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos da biblioteca React;
  • Experiência com testes unitários em JavaScript;
  • Domínio de design de APIs REST (preferencialmente com o framework Express);
  • Visão do modelo arquitetural de micro-serviços;
  • Experiência com design responsivo (media queries, propriedades relativas, flexbox, CSS grid);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de JavaScript e domínio dos paradigmas orientado a objetos e funcional da linguagem;
  • Conhecimento sobre GraphQL (preferencialmente com o framework Apollo);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoração (métricas de performance e erros);
  • Experiência com alguma ferramenta de CI/CD (preferencialmente GitLab CI);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de hint/lint (preferencialmente ESLint).

Desenvolvemos plataformas digitais e soluções que impulsionam negócios, promovendo eficiência, escalabilidade e experiências diferenciadas.

Com foco em atrair e desenvolver os melhores talentos, criamos oportunidades que transformam vidas e reforçam o papel positivo da tecnologia na sociedade


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

  • Procurar sempre criar a melhor experiência de uso para o usuário final, trabalhando de forma colaborativa com desenvolvedores, designers e stakeholders para garantir o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Participar ativamente na resolução de problemas complexos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo soluções inovadoras;
  • Escrever código limpo, testável, de fácil manutenção, utilizando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Participar ativamente do processo de revisão de código, atuando tanto como revisor quanto como autor, garantindo a qualidade e a funcionalidade das features desenvolvidas;
  • Acompanhar o comportamento das aplicações em produção usando as principais métricas de saúde e performance disponíveis nas ferramentas de monitoração, buscando insights de melhorias e entendendo anomalias a partir dessas métricas;
  • Atuar no backend que é a interface de consumo dos dados para todos os front-ends, garantindo resiliência e suporte à alta carga de acessos simultâneos;
  • Contribuir com a aplicação responsável pela entrega do site web do produto, utilizando o ambiente como campo de experimentação e aprendizado sobre o comportamento dos usuários.



REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES

  • Conhecimentos sólidos em Node.JS
  • Conhecimentos sólidos do sistema de controle de versão Git;
  • Visão sobre design patterns (Criacionais, Estruturais e Comportamentais);
  • Domínio de boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (DRY, KISS, TDA, SoC, SOLID);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos da biblioteca React;
  • Experiência com testes unitários em JavaScript;
  • Domínio de design de APIs REST (preferencialmente com o framework Express);
  • Visão do modelo arquitetural de micro-serviços;
  • Experiência com design responsivo (media queries, propriedades relativas, flexbox, CSS grid);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de JavaScript e domínio dos paradigmas orientado a objetos e funcional da linguagem;
  • Conhecimento sobre GraphQL (preferencialmente com o framework Apollo);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoração (métricas de performance e erros);
  • Experiência com alguma ferramenta de CI/CD (preferencialmente GitLab CI);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de hint/lint (preferencialmente ESLint).

title: Senior Magento Developer (Magento 2 / Performance Focus)
description:
Senior Magento Developer (Magento 2 / Performance Focus) | Remote


QAT Global, a QAT Global US-based IT consulting firm with more than 30 years in the market, is hiring a Senior Magento Developer in Brazil to join an international project supporting a US client.

This professional will work directly with client stakeholders in the US and collaborate with distributed teams across Brazil, Costa Rica, and the United States, contributing to performance improvements, technical analysis, and long-term platform stability in a complex Magento environment.


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Hiring Model: CLT only


Main Challenges:


  • Analyze and improve performance across the Magento platform, identifying backend, database, and front-end bottlenecks
  • Review legacy customizations and refactor technical debt impacting platform efficiency
  • Optimize JavaScript execution and storefront rendering performance
  • Evaluate modules, extensions, and integrations according to Magento best practices
  • Support code deployment and version control using GitHub and CI/CD workflows
  • Investigate root causes of production issues and propose scalable technical solutions
  • Contribute with architectural recommendations focused on scalability, maintainability, and security


Required Experience:


  • Strong professional experience with Magento development (Magento 2 strongly preferred)
  • Strong expertise in Magento architecture, module development, and customizations
  • Proven experience troubleshooting performance issues and legacy code problems
  • Solid knowledge of JavaScript performance optimization in Magento storefronts
  • Strong experience with PHP, HTML5, CSS, and codebase improvement
  • Experience with repository management and deployment workflows using GitHub
  • Ability to work directly with technical teams and client stakeholders in English


Preferred Background:


  • Magento caching and database optimization
  • CI/CD and DevOps practices
  • Code audits and technical health assessments
  • Large-scale e-commerce environments


This role is particularly relevant for professionals who have already worked with complex Magento environments, production troubleshooting, and technical modernization of existing platforms.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
As a Software Engineer , you will work closely with the product owner to shape the implementation of new features/sites. You will collaborate with the PO to write, refine, groom, and plan stories for feature implementation. You will also work with other teams when there are cross-team impacts to ensure integration is seamless and efficient.



Responsibilities

• Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development.

• Work well in Agile or Lean Software Development Life Cycle.

• Follow InComm standards and best practices, for logging, code review

• Manage and maintain lower environments (QA, UAT, Staging)

• Support production deployments

• Assist with production support, on-call schedule for DEV resources.

• Automate processes through SDLC to permit speed of delivery

• Ensure appropriate monitoring and alerting is in place prior to production deployments.

• Technical design and analysis of business use cases in preparation for development

• Able to quickly adjust and support changing priorities per business needs.

• Provide unit testing to ensure quality of builds in a continuous integration environment.

• Engage in production deployment co-ordination and verification

• Create documentation on the existing system and maintain documentation which includes current state of system flow, sequence diagrams, architecture diagrams, runbooks

• Participate in the full lifecycle of projects, including effective use of version control, build management, unit testing, and issue tracking software

• Effective verbal and written communication

• Problem solving skills and the ability to work with innovative solutions

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex situations and understand key issues quickly

• Ability to adapt in a dynamic work environment and make independent decisions while keeping management informed

• Work effectively in a team environment to produce good quality and timely results

• Able to work under tight deadlines while providing high-quality work

• Parse, analyze and understand system log files

• Customer Service orientation with the ability to effectively interact with users of all levels

• Able to proactively address system issues that have potential impact for the corporation

• Strong research, analytical, and troubleshooting skills

• Check and verify the applications are running and functioning properly after system updates

• Migration of platforms and application components.

• Support after-hours coverage/escalation & support on-call rotation


Qualifications

• Technologist, Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree

• At least 7 years of Software Development experience

• Experience with the full lifecycle of software development including use of version control tools, build management, unit testing, issue tracking software (e.g. SVN, Maven, Microsoft Visual Studio, JIRA)

• Java 17+

• Spring (data, boot, security, batch and actuator)

• In memory caching like Hazelcast

• Oracle 12c

• XML, JSON

• Hibernate, Hibernate/JPA

• REST Services

• API Management frameworks

• General SQL/Database experience, MS-SQL, Oracle

• Jenkins, Sonar

• JIRA & Confluence

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess complex systems and situations and troubleshoot issues

• Problem solving skills, critical thinking and strong decision-making skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication, and interpersonal interactions (ability to foster a cooperative work environment)

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
Position Summary:

We are seeking friendly and motivated Customer Support Specialists to serve our

customers and restaurant owners by providing assistance regarding account management

or order inquiries. This could include changes to their account, minor updates to their

menu, or inquiries about an order


Essential Responsibilities and Duties:

  • Take inbound calls from either the customer or the restaurant.
  • Make outbound calls to customers or restaurants to follow up on acknowledgement errors.
  • Manage incoming tickets generated from email or text via CRM (customer relationship management portal).
  • Return calls for any voicemails that a ticket is generated for Minor troubleshooting product or service problems reported by the customer or the restaurant.
  • Route calls / tickets to appropriate channels if necessary.
  • Facilitate and document accurate correspondence between the restaurant and customers
  • Miscellaneous clerical duties.


Education:

  • Minimum – High school diploma (or Equivalent)


Experience:

  • 6+ months work experience (Internship acceptable)
  • Fluent in English - Bilingual Spanish/English preferred
  • Must be available for evening and weekend shifts
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong critical thinking / problem solving skills
  • Preferred but not required:
  • Previous call center experience
  • Food Industry experience


What You Need For This Position:

  • Be flexible with working schedules, including nights and weekends
  • Efficient in operating a computer in a Windows based environment
  • Possess strong verbal and written communication skills in the English language
  • Communicate effectively in the English language
  • Have strong interpersonal skills, problem solving skills and negotiating skills
  • Think analytically
  • Work in a fast-paced environment
  • Be organized and have strong time management skills

  • Consultas das áreas clientes, renovações, esclarecimento de dúvidas acerca das disposições contratuais que não tenham cunho jurídico,
  • Administração do sistema de contratos, cuidando do acesso ao mesmo,
  • Análise da documentação pertinente aos contratos, disponibilizadas pelas áreas clientes, procurando dar segurança ao processo,
  • Executar outras atividades correlatas, conforme orientação superior.

  • Ensino Médio Completo

Desejável:

  • Ensino Superior em Administração, Direito ou áreas Afins.
  • Disponibilidade para Viagens



Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. title: Gerente de Operações Financeiras (Financial Operations Manager)
description:
Responsibilities:

  • Manage daily financial operations, including accounts payable/receivable, cash flow tracking, and crypto/stablecoin fund movements.
  • Liaise with accounting firms for bookkeeping, document preparation, SPED filings, and tax submissions (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS).
  • Maintain detailed records of all virtual asset activities to ensure compliance with internal audit and legal standards.
  • Collect and organize data for regulatory reporting to Receita Federal and the Central Bank of Brazil.
  • Monitor tax and foreign exchange compliance risks related to stablecoin-based transactions, and escalate issues as needed.
  • Handle foreign exchange filings and reports for cross-border crypto transactions (e.g., RDE-IED, SISCOSERV).
  • Assist in interpreting local regulatory developments and aligning operational processes accordingly.
  • Provide financial and operational insights to support management in budgeting and strategic planning.
  • Support internal reporting, KPI tracking, and process documentation.
  • Effectively utilize financial operations software, crypto custody tools, and dashboards.


Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience in operations, financial operations, or crypto-related back-office roles, preferably in fintech or Web3 environments.
  • Solid understanding of stablecoins, blockchain-based payment flows, and operational risk.
  • Familiarity with Brazilian financial reporting (SPED, Receita Federal, Central Bank) and tax compliance.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks with attention to detail.
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus.


What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • The chance to work on cutting-edge blockchain technology and make a significant impact in the industry.


Preferred Qualifications: proficiency in Spanish and Mandarin is a plus

  • Job type: Full Time


﻿Responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar as operações financeiras diárias, incluindo contas a pagar/receber, acompanhamento de fluxo de caixa e movimentações de fundos em cripto/stablecoins.
  • Coordenar junto às empresas de contabilidade a escrituração, preparação de documentos, arquivos SPED e submissões fiscais (IRPJ, CSLL, PIS/COFINS, ISS).
  • Manter registros detalhados de todas as atividades de ativos virtuais para garantir a conformidade com auditorias internas e padrões legais.
  • Coletar e organizar dados para relatórios regulatórios à Receita Federal e ao Banco Central do Brasil.
  • Monitorar riscos de conformidade fiscal e cambial relacionados a transações com stablecoins e escalar problemas conforme necessário.
  • Gerenciar registros cambiais e relatórios para transações transfronteiriças de criptomoedas (ex: RDE-IED, SISCOSERV).
  • Auxiliar na interpretação de novas regulações locais e alinhar os processos operacionais de acordo.
  • Fornecer insights financeiros e operacionais para apoiar a gestão na elaboração de orçamentos e planejamento estratégico.
  • Apoiar relatórios internos, rastreamento de KPIs e documentação de processos.
  • Utilizar efetivamente softwares de operações financeiras, ferramentas de custódia de cripto e dashboards.

Requisitos:

  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência em operações, operações financeiras ou funções de back-office relacionadas a cripto, preferencialmente em ambientes de fintech ou Web3.
  • Sólida compreensão de stablecoins, fluxos de pagamento baseados em blockchain e risco operacional.
  • Familiaridade com relatórios financeiros brasileiros (SPED, Receita Federal, Banco Central) e conformidade fiscal (tax compliance).
  • Fortes habilidades organizacionais e capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas tarefas com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Fluência em Português e Inglês; proficiência em Espanhol e Mandarim é um diferencial.

O que oferecemos:

  • Salário e benefícios competitivos.
  • Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e inovador.
  • A chance de trabalhar com tecnologia blockchain de ponta e causar um impacto significativo na indústria.

title: Senior Front End Engineer
description:
Senior Front End Engineer


Location: Brazil (Remote)



About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations.

For one of our clients, a mid-sized company operating at scale, we are currently looking to hire a Senior Front End Engineer.


Role Overview


We are seeking a Senior Front End Engineer to lead custom front-end development for a

Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud implementation. This role will be the first dedicated front-end

engineer on the project and is expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy,

technical ownership, and architectural judgment.

This is not a theme-tweaking role. You will design, build, and evolve a modern headless

front end integrated with Sitecore DXP and OrderCloud APIs.


Key Responsibilities


• Design and implement a custom headless front end for Sitecore DXP / OrderCloud

using modern JavaScript frameworks.

• Build production-grade applications using Next.js, with deployment targets such as

Vercel or Netlify.

• Integrate front-end applications with:

-OrderCloud APIs

-Sitecore DXP APIs

-Authentication, catalog, search, pricing, and checkout services

• Translate UX/UI designs into scalable, accessible, and performant front-end

implementations.

• Establish front-end architecture patterns, conventions, and best practices suitable

for a growing team.

• Collaborate closely with UX, product, and backend teams to ensure clean API

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.


Required Qualifications


• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns


• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience


• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

contracts and realistic implementation.

• Optimize performance, SEO, and Core Web Vitals for commerce use cases.

• Participate in technical decision-making around tooling, frameworks, and

deployment strategy.

• Own front-end code quality, testing approach, and release readiness.


Required Qualifications


• 5+ years of professional front-end development experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with Next.js and React in production environments.

• Experience building headless or composable front ends for CMS or commerce

platforms.

• Solid understanding of modern front-end architecture:

-SSR, SSG, ISR

-Client vs server components

-State management patterns


• Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.

• Experience integrating REST and/or GraphQL APIs.

• Familiarity with modern deployment platforms such as Vercel or Netlify.

• Familiarity with design systems and component-driven development.

• Comfortable working as an initial solo contributor while setting foundations for

future scale.


Preferred Experience


• Proactive use of AI-assisted code generation tools (e.g., Cursor + Claude) to:

-Accelerate development, refactoring, and prototyping.

-Design and implement automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) for

modern front-end applications.

-Leverage Figma MCP to translate Figma designs directly into production-

ready component code, reducing design-to-implementation cycle time.

• Hands-on experience with headless CMS/commerce platforms.

• Experience working on B2B or complex eCommerce applications.

• Ability to read, understand, and modify code in adjacent front‑end frameworks such

as AngularJS or similar React‑like ecosystems.


Benefits

  • Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements.
  • Flexible work environment.
  • Opportunities for professional and personal growth.

title: Programa Jovem Aprendiz 2026
description:
Por que trabalhar conosco?


O Butantan é o maior produtor de vacinas e soros da América Latina e o principal fabricante de imunizantes contra a gripe (influenza) do hemisfério Sul. Referência mundial de eficiência e qualidade, também é responsável por grande parte da produção de soros hiperimunes e vacinas oferecidos à população gratuitamente pelo Programa Nacional de Imunizações (PNI), como as vacinas contra hepatite A, hepatite B, HPV, raiva e DTPA.

Aqui no Butantan, valorizamos a diversidade.

Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, que se traduz no respeito à diversidade de gênero, etnia, pessoa com deficiência, orientação sexual (LGBTQIAPN+), crenças e religiões. Buscamos pessoas alinhadas aos nossos valores e que queiram crescer e se desenvolver junto com a instituição.


Buscamos um(a) profissional que atuará: Jovem Aprendiz (Administrativo/Produção):

  • Auxiliar nas rotinas dos Departamentos;
  • Realizar atendimento, acompanhamento de relatórios, input de dados em sistema;
  • Atender outras atividades profissionais correlatas e inerentes ao programa.


Quais são os requisitos imprescindíveis para essa vaga?

  • Ensino médio cursando ou completo
  • Conhecimento do Pacote Office
  • Ter entre 18 e 22 anos


Nosso pacote de benefícios:

  • Vale transporte;
  • Refeitório no local (para os dias presenciais no Complexo Butantan);
  • Vale Refeição (para os dias de treinamento externo);
  • Ônibus fretado - Instituto Butantan/ Metrô/Instituto Butantan;
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • Descontos em parcerias de entretenimentos;
  • Ingressos para os museus do Butantan;
  • Totalpass – benefício focado na saúde e bem estar dos colaboradores;
  • Avaliação de desempenho e auto avaliação;
  • Participação em palestras e Workshops realizados no Butantan;
  • Mentoria;
  • Day Off de aniversário – O (a) Aprendiz terá direito a uma folga no mês do aniversário, acordado com a gestão.


Informações complementares:

Período de inscrições: 16/03/2026 a 30/03/2026

Quantidade de vaga(s): 60

Local de Trabalho: São Paulo - Brasil

Horário de trabalho: 08h às 14h15 ou 12h às 18h15

Modelo de trabalho: Presencial


O processo seletivo será composto pelas seguintes etapas:

  • Análise curricular e triagem de candidatos;
  • Entrevista com recrutadores;
  • Entrevista individual com o requisitante;
  • Entrevista individual com o gestor do requisitante.


Todas as etapas são eliminatórias e podemos indicar uma ou mais etapas a informar no processo seletivo.


*Validade do processo seletivo: 06 meses

title: Analista Pleno de IAM
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista Pleno de IAM (gestão de identidade e acesso)



Resumo:

Estamos buscando um Analista Pleno de IAM experiente para se juntar à nossa equipe de cibersegurança. Este profissional será responsável por criar processos, configurar ferramentas e aprimorar os assuntos de IAM de forma global.

O profissional trabalhará em estreita colaboração com outras frentes de segurança, infraestrutura, sistemas e equipes de negócios, avaliando as melhorias e implementações necessárias para a eficácia do Programa de IAM.



Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter processos de gestão de identidades e acessos, incluindo provisionamento, revogação e revisão periódica de privilégios;
  • Administrar e implementar ferramentas relacionadas à IAM garantindo funcionamento, confiabilidade e atendendo aos requisitos de segurança;
  • Criar, revisar e otimizar regras, perfis, grupos e políticas de acesso, assegurando a aplicação de princípio de privilégio mínimo e SoD (Segregação de Funções), para ambientes on prem e cloud;
  • Auxiliar na estratégia para integração de sistemas e aplicações às plataformas de IAM;
  • Colaborar com outros times para mapear processos de acesso, identificar riscos e sugerir implementações ou automações de controles;
  • Apoiar times internos na compreensão das práticas de gestão de identidades, acessos e requisitos de segurança relacionados;
  • Suportar processos de auditorias.



Requisitos Técnicos e Experiência:

  • Experiência de ao menos 3 anos atuando diretamente com temas ligados à IAM;
  • Formação Superior em Tecnologia da Informação/Segurança da Informação;
  • Conhecimento em temas como AD/Entra ID, LDAP, SAML, Oauth, SSO, MFA, PAM, SoD, RBAC, princípio de menor privilégio e revisão de acessos;
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Defender for Identity, e demais ferramentas de IAM para ambientes híbridos e multicloud (On Prem, Azure, AWS, GCP);
  • Fluência em inglês;
  • Conhecimento em normas e boas práticas de segurança da informação (ex: ISO 27001, NIST, etc).



Requisitos desejáveis:


  • Certificações relevantes de fabricantes de soluções para IAM/PAM, exemplo:

(CyberArk, Senha Segura, BeyondTrust, SailPoint, Okta, Microsoft EntraID, etc).




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

  • Desenvolver, implementar e manter processos de gestão de identidades e acessos, incluindo provisionamento, revogação e revisão periódica de privilégios;
  • Administrar e implementar ferramentas relacionadas à IAM garantindo funcionamento, confiabilidade e atendendo aos requisitos de segurança;
  • Criar, revisar e otimizar regras, perfis, grupos e políticas de acesso, assegurando a aplicação de princípio de privilégio mínimo e SoD (Segregação de Funções), para ambientes on prem e cloud;
  • Auxiliar na estratégia para integração de sistemas e aplicações às plataformas de IAM;
  • Colaborar com outros times para mapear processos de acesso, identificar riscos e sugerir implementações ou automações de controles;
  • Apoiar times internos na compreensão das práticas de gestão de identidades, acessos e requisitos de segurança relacionados;
  • Suportar processos de auditorias.



Requisitos Técnicos e Experiência:

  • Experiência de ao menos 3 anos atuando diretamente com temas ligados à IAM;
  • Formação Superior em Tecnologia da Informação/Segurança da Informação;
  • Conhecimento em temas como AD/Entra ID, LDAP, SAML, Oauth, SSO, MFA, PAM, SoD, RBAC, princípio de menor privilégio e revisão de acessos;
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Defender for Identity, e demais ferramentas de IAM para ambientes híbridos e multicloud (On Prem, Azure, AWS, GCP);
  • Fluência em inglês;
  • Conhecimento em normas e boas práticas de segurança da informação (ex: ISO 27001, NIST, etc).



Requisitos desejáveis:


  • Certificações relevantes de fabricantes de soluções para IAM/PAM, exemplo:

(CyberArk, Senha Segura, BeyondTrust, SailPoint, Okta, Microsoft EntraID, etc).




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valoriza seus talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Junior Python Developer - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Python Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, and get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Create data integration services to help onboard new customers as quickly as possible.

- Maintain ongoing reliability, performance, and support of the data infrastructure, providing solutions based on application needs and anticipated growth.


Requirements:


- 1+ years of practical experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience in development with object-oriented programming is desirable.

- 1 year of development using other programming languages.

- Good skills with XML and relational databases (Oracle / MS SQL / MySQL).

- Strong professional experience working with large data structures (including XML) and algorithms.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Brazil Packaging Salesperson, Remote
description:
We are a leading cosmetic packaging company. Our product offerings support beauty, personal care, and cosmetic brands with high-quality, compliant, and market-ready packaging.


Role Description


We are seeking an experienced Brazilian Cosmetic Packaging Salesperson to join our sales team. This is a full-time remote position reporting to our Sales Manager. The ideal candidate will have proven experience selling cosmetic and personal care packaging products into Brazilian markets, with a strong understanding of Brazilian business practices, regulations, and cultural nuances.


Compensation: $65,000 to $135,000 per year, depending on experience.


Responsibilities


The successful candidate will be responsible for:


- Developing and maintaining relationships with Brazilian cosmetic and personal care brands

- Identifying and pursuing new sales opportunities within Brazil's cosmetic packaging market

- Presenting cosmetic packaging solutions tailored to brand, regulatory, and consumer requirements

- Managing sales pipelines, forecasting, and reporting

- Collaborating with product development, compliance, and logistics teams to ensure customer satisfaction

- Meeting and exceeding sales targets

- Staying informed on market trends, regulations, and competitor activity in Brazilian cosmetic packaging markets


Qualifications


- Proven track record of successful B2B sales in cosmetic packaging or closely related packaging industries

- Extensive experience working with Brazilian cosmetic, beauty, or personal care markets and customers

- Strong knowledge of Brazilian cosmetic packaging regulations, standards, and labeling requirements

- Fluent in English and Portuguese

- Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills

- Ability to travel to Brazil as needed (20-30% of the time)

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, or a related field

- Proficiency with CRM systems and sales tools

- Salesforce experience is a plus

title: Blockchain Payments Coordinator
description:
InvesTec UAE is a forward-looking technology company operating at the intersection of fintech and blockchain innovation. We are focused on building efficient, scalable financial infrastructure powered by digital assets, enabling seamless global payments through blockchain technology.


As we expand our operations, we are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Blockchain Payments Coordinator to support and optimize our crypto payment processes. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the core of digital asset operations and contribute to the evolution of next-generation financial systems.


Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate daily blockchain payment operations, including transaction processing, monitoring, and tracking.
  • Assist in managing crypto wallets, ensuring accuracy in transfers and balances.
  • Support reconciliation of transactions across wallets, exchanges, and internal systems.
  • Monitor payment flows and identify discrepancies or operational issues.
  • Collaborate with operations, compliance, and finance teams to ensure smooth and compliant processes.
  • Maintain accurate records of transactions and prepare operational reports.
  • Assist in managing relationships with payment providers, exchanges, and blockchain partners.
  • Stay updated on blockchain trends, tools, and best practices to improve operational efficiency.


Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in crypto, blockchain operations, fintech, or payments coordination.
  • Basic understanding of blockchain networks, wallets, and cryptocurrency transactions.
  • Familiarity with stablecoins (e.g., USDT, USDC) and crypto exchanges is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Good communication skills in English; Portuguese is a plus.
  • Self-motivated and able to work effectively in a remote, fast-paced environment.


What We Offer

  • Competitive annual salary: BRL 180,000–220,000
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours across Brazil
  • Opportunity to gain hands-on experience in blockchain payments and digital asset operations
  • Exposure to cutting-edge fintech and Web3 technologies
  • Supportive and collaborative international team environment
  • Professional growth and learning opportunities in a rapidly evolving industry
  • Performance-based bonuses linked to operational accuracy and efficiency

  • Basic understanding of blockchain networks, wallets, and cryptocurrency transactions.
  • Familiarity with stablecoins (e.g., USDT, USDC) and crypto exchanges is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.
  • Good communication skills in English; Portuguese is a plus.
  • Self-motivated and able to work effectively in a remote, fast-paced environment.


What We Offer

  • Competitive annual salary: BRL 180,000–220,000
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours across Brazil
  • Opportunity to gain hands-on experience in blockchain payments and digital asset operations
  • Exposure to cutting-edge fintech and Web3 technologies
  • Supportive and collaborative international team environment
  • Professional growth and learning opportunities in a rapidly evolving industry
  • Performance-based bonuses linked to operational accuracy and efficiency

title: Travel Designer
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Travel Designer to plan and execute highly curated itineraries for a sophisticated and growing global clientele.

This is a client-facing role focused on delivering seamless, personalized service. The ideal candidate has strong knowledge of luxury hospitality, understands the expectations of affluent travelers, and can manage multiple requests while transforming travel inspiration into flawlessly executed journeys.

You will collaborate closely with internal teams and trusted global partners to ensure every trip reflects the highest standards of luxury and service.

Profile

You are passionate about travel, detail-oriented, and skilled at building strong relationships with discerning clients. You intuitively understand their preferences and expectations, delivering highly personalized journeys with professionalism and care. Every interaction you lead reflects a refined standard of luxury service.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build bespoke, end-to-end itineraries tailored to each client’s travel style and preferences
  • Create and maintain long-term client relationships through prompt, thoughtful communication and flawless planning experience
  • Provide expert destination guidance with a strong understanding of luxury hospitality standards
  • Oversee all aspects of trip planning, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and seamless execution

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in luxury travel design, high-end hospitality, concierge, account management, or another sector within the luxury industry
  • Fluent in English (additional languages are a plus)
  • Proactive, resourceful, and solutions-oriented
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, able to manage multiple complex itineraries in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment while maintaining exceptional service standards
  • CV in English

title: Integration Analyst
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como Integration Analyst , apoiando iniciativas estratégicas de integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento em nuvem.
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir soluções utilizando .NET (C#) , aplicando boas práticas de arquitetura, SOLID e Design Patterns .
  • Criar, consumir e manter APIs REST , garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e performance.
  • Implementar e sustentar soluções em Azure , utilizando serviços como Azure Functions, App Services, Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault e Application Insights .
  • Trabalhar com integração de sistemas entre múltiplas plataformas , incluindo ambientes corporativos e parceiros externos.
  • Atuar com CI/CD , versionamento e automação utilizando GitHub e GitHub Actions .
  • Implementar e manter testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Garantir segurança de APIs , utilizando padrões como OAuth2 e JWT .
  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica clara e estruturada .
  • Colaborar com times técnicos internos, stakeholders de negócio e parceiros externos em um ambiente corporativo global.
  • Atuar em times Agile , participando de cerimônias Scrum e/ou SAFe.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos com desenvolvimento .NET (C#) .
  • Vivência prática com metodologias ágeis (Scrum e/ou SAFe).
  • Experiência comprovada com Azure Cloud , incluindo:
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure App Services
  • Azure Storage
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Azure Service Bus
  • Application Insights
  • Certificação AZ-104 – Azure Administrator .
  • Experiência com controle de versão (Git/GitHub) e pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Experiência em integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento de APIs REST .
  • Conhecimento em segurança de APIs (OAuth2, JWT).
  • Vivência com testes automatizados (unit e integration tests).
  • Aplicação consistente de Clean Code , Design Patterns e princípios SOLID.
  • Inglês avançado (escrita e conversação).


Será um destaque no seu perfil

  • Experiência com Salesforce , incluindo:
  • Lightning Web Components (LWC)
  • Apex Classes e Triggers
  • Flows
  • Experience Cloud (Builder)
  • Integração com APIs externas
  • Salesforce Commerce Cloud
  • Flosum
  • Conhecimento de objetos padrão e customizados no Salesforce.
  • Certificação AZ-204 – Developing Solutions for Microsoft Azure .
  • Experiência com publicação de aplicativos mobile (Apple Store e Google Play).
  • Familiaridade com Google Firebase .
  • Experiência prévia em ambientes corporativos multinacionais .
  • Certificações adicionais em integração ou tecnologias de desenvolvimento.


Onde você vai trabalhar

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office , com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

title: AI & Innovation Experience Designer
description:
AI & Innovation Experience Designer


About the Role

We are seeking an AI & Innovation Experience Designer to help define the next generation of intelligent commerce experiences. This role will focus on conceptualizing and designing new AI-powered capabilities and hyper-personalized shopping journeys for a large-scale digital marketplace platform.


You will own the AI Tools and Hyper-Personalization workstreams, exploring how generative AI, advanced data models, and intelligent systems can transform how customers discover products, interact with sellers, and navigate digital retail environments.


This role requires a designer who is comfortable operating in ambiguity and enjoys shaping 0-to-1 product concepts. You will translate emerging technologies into compelling user experiences through prototypes, concept designs, and future-state product visions.


What You’ll Do

  • Conceptualize new AI-powered commerce experiences across search, discovery, and personalized shopping journeys.
  • Design innovative features powered by generative AI and machine learning, such as contextual search, personalized product detail pages, AI-generated retail media, and intelligent seller tools.
  • Explore how data and personalization models can create dynamic, hyper-personalized user experiences throughout the shopping lifecycle.
  • Develop concept prototypes and design explorations that communicate future product possibilities and inspire product leadership.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and data teams to translate AI capabilities into meaningful user experiences.
  • Present forward-looking concepts and design narratives to stakeholders, helping shape the long-term product vision.
  • Operate within a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles and evolving requirements.


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product design or UX design, with exposure to emerging technologies or innovation-focused work
  • Experience designing AI-powered or data-driven product experiences
  • Strong conceptual thinking and ability to design future-state product concepts
  • Ability to communicate complex ideas through prototypes, visual concepts, and design storytelling
  • Understanding of personalization systems, recommendation engines, or conversational AI patterns
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, early-stage product environments
  • Fluency in Portuguese (required working language)
  • Ability to work effectively in fast-paced consulting environments


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience designing GenAI-powered features, including conversational interfaces, AI search, content generation, or recommendation systems
  • Familiarity with retail media platforms, seller tools, or marketplace ecosystems
  • Experience designing for conversational commerce platforms such as messaging-based shopping experiences
  • Exposure to or interest in the Brazilian or Latin American technology ecosystem

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Data Engineer

Brazil

Data Analyst II

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a SQL & Snowflake Engineer, you will play a key role in the full development lifecycle, translating complex data structures into actionable technical insights with a specific focus on Snowflake and SQL queries. You will be responsible for both querying and analyzing large datasets within the Data Lake to support feature development, ensuring seamless data availability from ingestion through to reporting within an Agile framework. Beyond technical execution, you will act as a key contributor in data modeling, actively participating in technical discussions to help the engineering team understand underlying data patterns and quality issues.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Digest requirements from the engineering team and specify the implementation of complex SQL queries;
  • Analyze and map underlying data schemas within Snowflake to support application logic;
  • Optimize SQL performance for large-scale data retrieval and reporting;
  • Follow Agile processes and participate actively in data exploration phases;
  • Participate in technical discussions, data quality reviews, and schema design sessions.

Essential Skills


  • Solid Experience with Snowflake (architecture, warehousing, and data sharing);
  • Strong proficiency in Advanced SQL (CTEs, Window Functions, Stored Procedures);
  • Familiarity with ETL/ELT processes and data ingestion tools;
  • Solid experience with version control for database scripts (Git, Liquibase, or dbt).

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Cloud knowledge (AWS/Azure/GCP) regarding data storage (S3/Blob);
  • Experience with Python or scripting for data manipulation;
  • Familiarity with semi-structured data (JSON, Parquet) with Snowflake.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

organizations making an impact through technology.

culture, send us your CV!
